[{"Name":"anita makgetla","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVs53XpvcvPr4TNA0pYMpjEVyUbENevLApkBG56MwQ4H7BEvOY=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE! Updated to include a second complaint

Attie is absolutely unprofessional and disrespectful.

About a year ago, I contacted Attie to fix a sewage pipe that was problematic (old house so the pipe needed to be replaced with a more modern equivalent) and necessitated the digging up of a portion of my driveway. Initially, I thought I was going to repave my whole driveway so he didn't quote me for closing the hole. I subsequently decided I would have his team close the whole, for which he charged me an additional R1100. His team came and did a terrible job of closing the hole so the concrete sank and I still had a hole in my driveway. This was in February of 2022. I have been chasing him for a year to fix the hole and been given every excuse under the sun as well as him telling me he's "coming tomorrow" and never showing up. He is disrespectful of peoples time and shows himself to be deeply unprofessional.

I have given him every  opportunity to fix it (constantly messaging to enquire when he will fix it) and when I told him today that I would leave a bad review he became rude and belligerent, even blaming me for his not finishing the job and threatening me. I have never received such bad service as a homeowner ever.

Update: I had another service provider finally repair the botched job. they charges me R320 to fix my driveway, thus proving not only is Attie unprofessional, but he also charge wildly scammer prices.

Update #2:
Since posting this review I have had another incident on my property due to the incompetence of this plumber.

Today, out of the blue, my geyser started leaking. I was recommended a plumber by a neighbour. After looking at the geyser he told me whoever had installed the most recent element and thermostat had installed it badly resulting in rusting that had ultimate resulted in this leak. I asked him if this could be a simple mistake that any plumber could make or if it was shoddy workmanship. He said it was the type of mistake a good plumber would not make.

I'm sure it will shock you, dear reader, to hear that Attie and his team were the last people to touch my geyser... Best plumbers in the great JHB area.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Leon Vivier","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWj8jH2lnqorYhP6fxBnOpySuV6ummiy49VqR1YVaFqmtALIB6S=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Arranged with them to install a non-return valve on the geyser's hot water pipe in my roof.  Installation of the valve itself was perfectly fine.  The problem is that they did the installation by lifting up roof tiles and tearing down a meter stretch of radiant shielding I personally installed.  They did not put this shielding back in place/where they found it when they were done and just left it torn and hanging.  They did this because, I am assuming, they were too lazy to carry their ladder up my stairs to the second floor and go through the trap door like they are supposed to.  Seeing as your plumbers do not know the purpose of the shielding it is two-fold: Firstly, to keep solar heat out and radiant heat in.  Secondly, to seal the roof completely from external air flow. Great service.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Nastasia Blamire","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWE-9r_LWQxkskwoCWasnHIP59cUbYlcwfnUI29wmD3G-_2pRoaKA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I really don’t like complaining, and I’ve just been pushed to my end with this situation. I also don’t expect perfection, but I do expect people to take pride in their work. If this is what they are proud to hand over to a customer or client, I am honestly shocked.

I am extremely disappointed with this company and regret ever using them.

The booking process was smooth, which gave me high hopes. But what was supposed to be a small maintenance job — tightening a few taps and replacing one toilet tap — turned into a nightmare. Even though the issue seemed minor, I was told that things couldn’t be fixed and had to be replaced. I trusted their advice, allowed the work to be done, and then paid the price.

A few days later, when I turned the tap on, it made a terrible knocking vibration noise. I phoned the company, showed them a video, and they agreed to send the plumber out. The plumber came when I wasn’t home and left a note saying that the pressure valve and something else now needed to be replaced. When I phoned to ask about it, I was told it wasn’t the plumber’s fault, that these things can happen, and that even if I asked my dad, he would say the same — that when taps and plumbing are replaced, buildup in the pipes can move and damage the valve. What bugged me the most is that they avoided accountability and could not explain to me why the other taps were not making a noise, only the new taps, or why it wasn’t affecting any of the other taps, only the new ones.

The tap then stopped making the noise somehow after they had come and touched something. Now it seems to be okay. I told them it looked fine for now, and we left it there.

A couple of days later, I discovered the other basin that had been taken off in another part of the house — basically the second basin that was replaced. The taps there also seemed to be poorly installed, because there were already problems with them. On top of that, the basins were left with broken tiles put back in place, messy silicone, and shoddy workmanship. If the guys had told me the tiles broke when they did it, I would have been okay with the situation. But instead, they hid it and simply covered it up. When I phoned to complain, the company’s attitude was blasé once again. On that call, I said the workmanship was horrendous, and I was told I must use nicer words when the plumber comes, that I can’t say “horrendous.” But that is how I truly felt. Why must I sugarcoat poor workmanship when I’ve paid a significant amount of money? The guys came back again today, tell me they sorted the basin and taps out but they are still not okay. I really regret asking for them to do the job because I feel like Im going crazy as the problems before were nothing near what I have now.

The taps themselves really don’t seem to replace the value of the taps that were already in. It just seems that these taps are problematic, whether it’s the way they were installed or the taps themselves. I don’t understand how all four taps can be a problem — and in two different parts of the house, with two separate geysers and two separate valves that would supposedly need to be replaced. It concerns me because none of the other taps in my house have issues — only the new taps.

In the end, I’ve now had to call my trusted plumber — the one I should have used from the start — to fix their mess. I normally have to wait for my plumber, but now I understand why: quality takes time, and I should have just been patient instead of trying to give someone else a chance. This company has cost me money, time, and frustration. The workmanship, the attitude, and the lack of accountability are absolutely disgusting. Do not use Linden Plumbing for gas geyser issues. You will be disappointed.

We were referred to Jurgens and his team in July 2024. Initially response to my query was prompt, but problems started when it came to arriving at our house to check the faulty gas geyser. It was only when I asked EasiGas for another referral that Jurgens finally sent someone to repair our geyser.

Fast forward to October this year. The same geyser gives problems. I ask Jurgens again since the excuse in July was that it was extremely cold and many electric geysers had burst because of the cold. There is no urgency to get to our case, so we went with another service provider, whose customer service was just slightly better than Jurgens's.

I contact Jurgens again at the beginning of December. He gives me very useful information that makes it clear that the faulty geyser will need to be replaced. I decide to give him one last chance. His guy comes to look at the geyser the very next day. Jurgens promised to send me a quote and other documents required for us to claim for the installation of a new geyser from our insurer. It's now been two weeks since that conversation and still no quote. Both my husband and I have asked for the quote to be sent, but there are excuses and promises that it'll come, but nothing happens.

It's clear that business is so good that Linden Plumbing does not need our business, so we've gone with a different installer who has provided us with a quote on the day we contacted him and will do the installation the day after. I told Jurgens that if we receive the same customer service as the last two times, I'll write a bad online review. Highly recommend them","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sandy G","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK4G23u7PizNCr-HO92J_g0tBuKlLsAlo8DvRR1lp4xh4KHL_z8=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"What started off as a simple leak on a galvanized pipe at ground level, ended up with multiple problems. After the initial visit, which involved replacing a portion of the erroded pipe and using a lot of force to separate the deeper portion of the pipe, two things directly resulted. Firstly, because the open end of the pipe was not blocked off, a lot of sand got into the pipe supplying my bathrooms, resulting in my filters being blocked up. The worst was my float valve in the toilet which was completely blocked with sand, and not rust, and they couldn't fix that, so they replaced that with a new unit and I was charged for that. I don't believe I should have paid for that as it was as a direct result on their part in not blocking off the open pipe. Also once that was replaced, the water level in the cistern was set at half full. Because the unit was replaced in such a position, it now doesn't allow for adjustments as it's impossible to rotate the unit in order to increase the water level.
The second thing resulting from the rough handling of the pipe, was that it resulted in a split in the pipe and water leakage.
A new team arrived 4 days later and they replaced that pipe and fittings from the previous fix which was also leaking.
However, there was now a leak at one of the T joints. So a team arrived the next day and replaced the whole network of pipes. However, the next day I noticed that where they disconnected the polycop pipe to gain access to the other pipes and reconnected it, there was now a leak there.
They then came back the next day and re fitted the polycop pipe which stopped the leak.
They suggested leaving the area open to make sure there were no more leaks. This was done for 5 days. They seemed satisfied that all was good and closed up the brickwork.
However, I noticed that the brickwork was still showing signs of a leak.
I received their bill and paid in full, sending an email to them with pics showing the brickwork and also mentioning about the toilet float replacement.
I didn't receive the courtesy of a reply from them!
I certainly wouldn't recommend them.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lencheon Maluleka","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV-a6osi_h8C7HauMBy-30jHYZW16WlbBhr3yTF6XAZU9m0_O9X=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The team was friendly and did an excellent job. With winter here, households rely on kettles, heaters, and electric blankets for warmth. A burst geyser can be a major hassle, especially during the cold months. Acting quickly can save you costly repairs and ensure your safety. At Plumbing 4U, we treat geyser issues as emergencies.

Emergency Geyser Services Available 24/7
Plumbing 4U offers 24/7 emergency services for any geyser crisis, providing same-day solutions with no after-hours surcharge. If you suspect your hot-water system is faulty, follow these crucial steps:

Act Immediately

Time is critical with a burst geyser. Leaking hot water can damage walls, floors, and furnishings. Act at the first sign of trouble to save on repair costs. Look out for low water pressure, moisture stains, or unusual noises.

Turn Off the Power Supply

Prevent the tank from overheating by turning off the geyser switch on your main electrical board. If you can't find it, turn off all power at the main circuit breaker.

Shut Off the Water Supply

Stop water from flowing into the tank by turning off the water supply at the mains. The valve is often near the water meter, so locate it before an emergency occurs.

Relieve System Pressure

To reduce internal pressure, open hot-water taps and let them run for a few minutes. Cold-water taps may also help drain the tank.

Get Professional Help Quickly

Contact a 24-hour plumber immediately to prevent further damage. Plumbing 4U’s emergency services are handled by professional plumbers registered with the PIRB. We use only SABS-approved parts for your peace of mind.

When it comes to burst geyser repairs and replacements, trust our experts with decades of experience. For fast, reliable, and affordable services, contact Plumbing 4U today.

Stay warm and safe this winter with Plumbing 4U’s emergency services – your go-to solution for all geyser-related issues.

Second day I phoned, Ivan said they got busy and tried phoning me to explain (unfortunately I received no call but gave them benefit of the doubt) Ivan said they would come to my house later that day. The agreed upon time came and no one arrived. I phoned Ivan again and he said he was going to make a plan. Not too long after Ivan arrived at my house, he said he is not a plumber but maybe he can have a look at the toilet, desperate to have the toilet work again I said sure have a look, Ivan kept saying he is not a plumber so he cannot guarantee that the toilet will work. I again gave them benefit of the doubt. Great, Ivan said it was not something major and he fixed it. We had a long conversation and I asked Ivan that seeing as he is not a plumber what do I do in the event that the toilet gives me trouble again, he replied confidently that if there are any issues in the first 3 months that they will come back and sort it out for me and this time he will bring the plumber. I agreed, said thanks and paid Ivan the fee charged although he is not a plumber, hoping that if something went wrong that they would have my back, at least for a short while. Nice of Ivan he gave me R70 off…

20 days later (of which we were on holiday and did not use the toilet for 10 days) the toilet started doing the exact same thing. So knowing that Ivan said they will come have a look I sent him a message.

His response, just fix it yourself, you cannot expect me to come back a month later to fix something that I (not a plumber charging plumbing rates) already fixed.

Just shocking from Ivan, I really thought after our discussion and me placing my trust in him that they would just assist me when something goes wrong not even a month later.

Needless to say this reflects badly and George is probably a good plumber etc. But never send your admin assistant to fix things. I am still waiting for my invoice and it seems Ivan is now ignoring me, more empty promises as he said he will send it multiple times

Even outsurance is better.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sonja Bakker","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXyPVMNoEPzBqLPLmWTeHzM3pubUdD0IGWXtFK7A3XpL0uVnKY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"It is with regret that I write this review, as I generally had a positive experience with this broker in the past. However, the past year has been a nightmare. After suffering water and mould damage due to a storm last year, I submitted a claim to replace the affected ceilings. Unfortunately, I was informed that my claim would only be paid out after spending R47,000 on painting and sealing the roof tiles and replacing the cement on the roof ridge, allegedly due to inadequate roof maintenance. Do keep in mind that I have never previously had a leak in my roof and has not, since the date of the incident.

The appointed contractor did not inspect the damage inside my ceiling or roof but instead took pictures from the outside. Additionally, the contractor chose not to include the second room, despite my explanation that mould spreads and both ceilings needed replacement. The quote also failed to cover the damage to the roof trusses and insulation.

In January, I lodged a complaint with the ombudsman, who ruled in my favor in early May. However, the ruling only covered the work listed by the contractor. To have the excluded items replaced, I would need to file another complaint with the contractors regulatory body, which I plan to do after resolving the current issues.

Regarding Van Flymen, the level of unprofessionalism and disdain I experienced was disheartening. After signing the necessary paperwork, I had to repeatedly inquire about the first payment. Despite assurances that the payment was processed, proof of payment revealed it was only done at 13:56 this afternoon, a week after my initial inquiries.

Previously, I would have recommended Van Flymen without hesitation. However, after this ordeal and a year of waiting for mouldy ceilings to be replaced, I now suggest finding your own insurance and dealing directly with the insurance company. This approach would provide direct information and avoid relying on a broker who appears disinterested in providing satisfactory service. During this process, only about 20% of my phone calls were returned, and I was frequently given incorrect information. Had I dealt with Bryte directly, I doubt I would have been waiting a year.

Update: Even though I did explain to Van Flymen numerous times that I have legal obligations that needs to be settled and the funds needed to be in my account so that I do not breach this agreement, it did not happen. I contacted the broker 5 times on Friday asking for an update and proof of payment, I did not receive one phone call from them, needless to say neither a payment or proof of payment. I cannot think that a company can deteriorate this much in one year. The individual that was dealing with my claim was booked of sick and I fully understand but that nobody from the broker came back is not acceptable. It seems that the only time they actually are effective is when you speak to the owner/director after battling for a year to settle a mould claim. Just do keep in mind that the ombudsman did judge in my favour and both the broker and the insurance company was instructed to settle my claim. And this was after I requested a transcript on the recording when taking out my insurance as they kept om making me out to be a liar and that what I am claiming (mind you this second claim resulted due to their decision not to honour my claim) was not covered. I am extremely disappointed in both the broker for their dishonestly and Bryte in not honour my claim resulting in me going through a year of hell living with mould and dishonourable conduct by both the broker and insurance company.
Update with regards to Bryte, I received a call from the CEO and we had a discussion and he did apologise for what happened with my claim. For that and his honesty, I would go back to Bryte as their service in general is good and they do cater for insurance cover that is not always provided for by all insurances.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Somayya Motalau","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKA7v0lfC1RFjc0myAGaiFYz3vJmwo1dpSKBTW9NT7X13Hsxw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Terribly rude

Then out of the blue I get a call saying they can no longer cover me unless I take out additional insurance. After 6 years of loyalty, that's how you find out you're no longer wanted as a customer.

I've since spoken to two other people who were told the exact same thing, so it's clearly not a one-off. It's disappointing and frankly quite telling that long-term, reliable customers are treated this way. Loyalty clearly counts for nothing here.

Would not recommend.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lelona Nombakuse","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIyXpLh9d1k7ZlosZSp1E82QzsFl1BlzuLXI9i7f0XZltz01XfF=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"My experience with Sela Brokers and Hollard Insurance

I am deeply disappointed with how my claim has been handled. It’s been five months since the accident caused by their client, and there is still no resolution or meaningful progress. Communication has been sparse, unclear, and unhelpful.

My claim was frustratingly handed over to another party, apparently Hollard, but this has only deepened the confusion and incompetence. Neither Sela nor Hollard has taken responsibility or provided clarity.

As a third-party claimant, I expected a fair and efficient process. Instead, I’ve been left waiting, with no updates, no resolution, and no accountability.

I do not recommend dealing with Sela Brokers or Holland Insurance. Their lack of transparency and disregard for claimants’ concerns is unacceptable.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Beverley Cummins","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJSZjFaPqIxR8ve7juDatTV1mnbpAmtGYGb4irWLVJyvQ7eqA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"As a 50% shareholder in my businesses, Sela Brokers refuses to provide me with any information regarding the existing insurance policies including claims and instead directs me to obtain the information from the other 50% shareholder. They were caring and always available to answer questions and support the process. Thank you!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Rox-Anne Maistry","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWajfmSvRTNNTF5DzrEQGvd76rZodUIFBIPvUYnLBmr4UMjrzEr=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"The electricity was disconnected on Friday, 6 March 2026, 1 Embridge Flat, Windsor West. & to date it has still not been restored.

My husband, Ezekiel, contacted Norma from Just Property regarding the disconnection while the City Power team was present at the premises. Norma requested to speak to the City Power representative, which she did, after which the call was disconnected.

When my husband called Norma back, she informed him that the owner of the property was attending to the matter. Later, when he called again for feedback, Norma indicated that the owner was going to the COJ (City of Johannesburg) offices to resolve the issue.

My husband requested Yolande’s contact number, as her number had changed. Norma said she would send the number via WhatsApp. However, despite my husband requesting the contact details, the message was never responded to. My husband also requested the owner’s contact details, but Norma advised that she was unable to provide the owner’s number.

My husband attempted to call Norma again later in the afternoon and also tried contacting the Just Property office, but there was no response.

Eventually, after checking through his call logs, my husband managed to find the owner’s contact details and contacted her directly. The owner informed him that she was at the COJ offices & that the electricity supply would be restored within 72 hours.

However, the electricity has still not been restored.

What is particularly concerning is that we received no further feedback from the agency regarding the matter. There was no after-hours contact provided, and there was no one available for us to contact during the weekend.

In the meantime, the impact on our household has been significant:

1.	Due to the lack of electricity, food & perishable items in our refrigerator began to spoil & have to be thrown away.
2.	I am diabetic, & my medication must be kept refrigerated according to my prescription. This situation has created a serious health concern & risk.
3.	Our daughters are currently studying, & our younger daughter began her exams on Monday, 9 March. Because of the electricity outage, we had to arrange alternative accommodation for her to study & prepare for her exams, & we had to book a bed and breakfast. This was an unplanned expense, in addition to the stress placed on her during an already demanding exam period. She is still writing exams this week.

This situation has become a serious concern as the disconnection of electricity has been an ongoing issue, causing repeated inconvenience, additional expenses, and unnecessary stress for our family.
I am also reminded of a previous period when my husband was unemployed, & we were unable to make full rental payments. Despite communicating our situation to the agency  & the owner at the time, our electricity & water were still disconnected until payment was made.

During that difficult time, we struggled greatly, yet no empathy was given, instead action was taken immediately.

My husband has also always tried to assist whenever issues arise on the property. On numerous occasions when COJ disconnected electricity to the property, he was the person who contacted & informed the agency.

Therefore, the lack of response & support from the agency during this situation has been extremely disappointing and unfair. From midday on Friday until Monday, we were unable to get in contact with anyone from the agency, and there was no communication or proper feedback provided.

We kindly request that:

•	This matter be treated with urgency regarding the restoration of the electricity supply.
•	We receive clear and proper communication regarding when the electricity will be restored.
•	We are informed what steps will be taken to prevent this ongoing issue from happening again in the future.
•	The agency provide and confirm a reliable after-hours emergency contact, so that a situation such as this past weekend is not repeated.

We trust that you will understand the seriousness of this situation and take the necessary steps to resolve it urgently.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Kwezi Nyati","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVFr11zn6_rrfG0FPLUouifydPqKMLRzNEA2LNsMVy82W4CY1b_=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had the good fortune of meeting Dean Thorndike in the year 2022 when he leased a property to me. I have always mentioned to him my wish to purchase a property and he has been patiently trying to assist with this.

Finally towards the end of 2025 he found one for me and with the greatest patience, guided me through the process. I am really appreciative of this as property purchasing is quite a daunting task. With Dean this has really felt like I have someone who is on my corner and truly has my best interests at heart. Please relay my gratitude to him for all that he is in my life.

Sincerely
Kwezi Nyati","Images":null,"When":""}]

We were required to pay a deposit and sign a lease before being allowed to inspect the property. When we eventually inspected the unit, it was in a poor and unsafe condition, with multiple serious defects formally recorded in the ingoing inspection report.

We immediately cancelled and never took occupation.

Throughout the process, it felt as though our rights as tenants were not properly considered, and that the interests of the landlord were prioritized at every step. This created a strong impression of bias and a lack of impartial handling of the matter, which is highly unprofessional.

In particular, our dealings with Dean Ganget left us feeling that our legitimate concerns were dismissed, and that no genuine effort was made to consider our position as tenants.

Ynnis Wilson repeatedly attempted to apply pressure around fees and deductions and tried to justify withholding part of our deposit, despite the fact that the property was not fit for occupation and we never moved in.

Only after persistent measures and threats to take the matter further legally was a refund processed, and even then the payment was short and had to be chased again.

Based on our experience, I would strongly caution prospective tenants to insist on inspecting a property before paying any deposit or signing any agreement.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"ThandekaM","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVuR8hwSZMcJLsBi2uZ8iXPuJPmcDgQzWnw4liIrA0hGLF6maYD=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Such horrible service from Lina, who was recommended to me.

The cherry on top is the fact that she came to my place and suggested a certain amount for rental (of which I personally told her its above what I want - obviously knowing the rentals in the Complex). As landlords, we have had to continually follow up—often multiple times—with both the tenant and the agent, simply to obtain basic updates or to prompt action that should form part of their mandated responsibilities.

Although Tyson Properties carries out some administrative tasks, their actions can only be described as delayed, indifferent, and devoid of any proactive management. At this point, it feels as if we are managing our own property, while still being expected to pay them for a service that is not being competently delivered.

Our interactions with staff—specifically Amy—have also been unacceptably unprofessional. She has put the phone down in our ear, which any reasonable person would deem rude, dismissive, and wholly inappropriate for someone working in a position of fiduciary responsibility.

The consequences of this mismanagement are severe. My mother, the property owner, is now struggling to eat because there is no money, as the rental income she depends on is simply not being collected—yet Tyson Properties still expects their full management fee every month, despite failing to uphold their end of the arrangement.

In my opinion, based on the ongoing pattern of behaviour, Tyson Properties demonstrates:

A complete lack of urgency in resolving rental arrears

Poor communication and unprofessional conduct

Rudeness and disrespect during telephonic interactions

No proactive approach to enforcing obligations

A disregard for the landlord’s financial situation despite contractual duties

From a contractual standpoint, their conduct raises concerns regarding reasonable duty of care, proper execution of mandate, and good-faith performance, all of which are fundamental in any property management relationship.

I signed a contract in March and have since paid R32,191.95 across seven invoices for virtually no service.

My experience has been a chaotic cycle of multiple team changes, two separate onboarding sessions, and constant confusion about who is responsible for my account. For four months after the initial onboarding, there was complete silence, only broken when I sent an email asking what I was paying for.

In the seven months that followed, I received:

-One management report.
-One over-estimated provisional tax calculation with no strategic guidance.
-My bank accounts have been reconciled in 3 months despite having the monthly bookkeeping package
-I was paying for two accounting systems (QuickBooks and Xero) for months because no one had transfered the historical data required over.
- After two onboarding meetings where it was agreed upon, I am still not VAT registered.

After all this time and money, I have received minimal, incorrect, and delayed deliverables. I did more of the work than the firm did during that time on my accounts. [{"Name":"Magdil Delport","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWhiTDP4cuCeOXqBMY-yz2X3v_Ps2JdDhLVSuSyu_QhbDf8wjY=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I’ve been using TCSA for about five years now, and they have consistently provided reliable and professional service. Dealing with people like André, Rehnu, Priscilla and Brigitte over the years has been an absolute pleasure.

Most recently, they assisted me with lodging an objection with SARS, who had incorrectly reassessed my tax and claimed that I owed a substantial amount. The objection was handled thoroughly and efficiently by André and the team, and it was successfully resolved — even resulting in a refund from SARS.

As someone living in the Channel Islands, it’s particularly important for me to ensure my South African tax affairs remain fully compliant, especially given that there is currently no double tax agreement in place between South Africa and the Channel Islands. This makes it one of the regions that SARS keeps a particularly close eye on, so having knowledgeable tax consultants is essential.

TCSA’s understanding of cross-border tax considerations and their ongoing support over the years have been invaluable. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for experienced and dependable tax professionals, particularly where international tax matters are involved.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Carl van Niekerk","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJhcea4wbzQ6Yjzu4hITqiML8-OcuPK8lvsEyuKc4A2PhDaKw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"In 2017, I emigrated from South Africa, and in 2025 I approached Tax Consulting South Africa for assistance with applying for non–tax resident status. The process was handled with exceptional professionalism, and thanks to their expertise, everything was completed in about six months. During this time, they also finalized my outstanding 2019–2025 tax submissions. I was kept informed throughout and never needed to follow up.

Once my non–tax resident status was finalized, SARS raised a dispute regarding my 2018 tax return related to the sale of my house. They claimed I owed a substantial amount in capital gains tax. I immediately contacted Tax Consulting South Africa, who put me in touch with André Daniels. After reviewing the documents, André confirmed that they could assist. Once I provided the necessary information, André and his team not only succeeded in having the alleged amount removed, but they also determined that I was actually due a refund for that tax year.

I am extremely grateful to Tax Consulting South Africa for their assistance, dedication, and expertise throughout this matter.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Leander Geldenhuys","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVfqrY6JTOfZsv-3Ij9SzuDvpgbQTv16lAGvuodnoeBW5PZNA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had a dispute with my Tax for the 2022 Tax year that changed from SARS owing me money which they said could not be paid into my bank account because my bank account could not be verified by them, to a re-assessment they then performed resulting in me owing them a very large amount of money. SARS claimed that there was an error on my returns that was submitted by my previous accountant, and they therefore didn't consider the Tax that I had already paid abroad. I contacted TAX Consulting South Africa to assist me with the dispute. André Daniels, Buyile Zondi and Micaela Adams took my case on and they spent a lot of time and effort to submit various documents and statements to SARS who kept on requesting additional information. Yesterday, the dispute was finally accepted by SARS, who drastically reduced the amount and interest I have to pay in. I am grateful to TAX Consulting SA for their dedication and persistent follow up of my case with SARS. Thank you for the detailed appeals and communication submitted to SARS and for the constant feedback about the status and progress of the case.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lenny Le Roux","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJWWhxvvLv8VtpQWZKEN4ODdMNbr-nsLHN38w5weXerUz8a_g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had a tax enquiry and Junaid, along with his team, provided an exceptional service. title: FIRZT Realty Company
user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Aleya Ramparsad Banwari","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVmqPV-1HJsOzS7_kCU2KgcmwZs96ZF8zvsGpJawisX6booVew=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I am profoundly disappointed by the level of unprofessionalism displayed by Firzt Realty, specifically Kaveer and Pamella. What should have been a straightforward rental mandate turned into an exhausting and entirely avoidable experience.

From the outset, I was clear and consistent about the terms of the listing. Kaveer explicitly advised that if the apartment were to be rented semi-furnished, items such as crockery, cutlery, and linen should be removed, which I did. Despite this being discussed and agreed upfront, I was repeatedly asked every few weeks over the two-month listing period whether these items were in the apartment. This was particularly concerning given that both agents visited the apartment far more frequently than I did. I was even asked, at the last minute, to move these items back into the apartment, despite my position having been made clear multiple times. This reflected poor attention to detail and basic client management.

I was equally clear that the rental needed to remain financially viable and that I could not rent the apartment at a loss. After more than two months on the market without a tenant secured, I nevertheless agreed to three price reductions. Communication throughout this period was poor, reactive rather than proactive, and required constant follow-ups on my part.

Due to the prolonged vacancy and lack of confidence in the service provided, I informed Firzt that I would hand the listing over to another agency if no tenant was confirmed within one week. In response, Kaveer requested a fourth price reduction, citing a neighbouring apartment rented for over R4,000 less, despite that unit being unfurnished, lacking a parking bay, and not including appliances such as a TV, fridge, oven, stove, air conditioner, or Wi-Fi extender. I subsequently terminated the mandate.

On the day my keys were meant to be returned, I was ignored. Pamella contacted me after 19h00 proposing to drop the keys at the vacant apartment, despite knowing I no longer live there. I explicitly instructed that the keys be delivered to my parents’ home, shared the address, and informed my mother to expect her. Pamella agreed, and then did not arrive.

The withholding of my keys was unacceptable. Kaveer was fully aware of my parents’ address and lives less than five minutes away, making the delay entirely unreasonable. The keys were only returned after I threatened formal escalation, and when they were returned, they were in a visibly neglected and damaged condition, covered in grease and showing signs of rust, despite having been in Firzt’s possession for only two months.

Most concerning was the complete lack of accountability. No meaningful apology was offered. Even after I formally terminated the mandate, Pamella continued to contact me to arrange viewings, including a Sunday afternoon request with less than two hours’ notice.

This experience demonstrated a serious lack of professionalism, urgency, and respect for clients. I would not trust Firzt Realty to secure a tenant, let alone manage a rental property, and would not recommend this agency or these agents to any landlord or prospective buyer or tenant.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERo_EsOzD0ipxtCHeNrL5OZTmmCsvx3z5kV9eUuQDpnbvUuLYjxYewlx664ohABgstflqshKHxq_E4eIhJUL0pgdqxjV_lBSjZBH7vLhE7QivawgfTJObWKG6Wbr7ZOexikyk5Zusr30n6L","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQKtobiW_CzkISykERlzRGDqIIIlGBpcaPxYymfizMCBYJWvuQB6UFOt4ugoF3ZkI3BExAqIJmn09xDXpzmtotnI9WwgCnr1MXc06-9vh9m7t4QJc73uRf3FCt540QOrRuHeIy6nrxJ1y5G","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETIgOVp1JFzXf-GZTbwl9-Rb_zK96bCs0ElYbC7K8UqWLsvJoy8ZhGqBxHBhU5Qnmk4k1aNsW8f75SwlBL4OjM7gjEPdUc5zVIpl0QYbctTlMhFjmynAa56Ha5y_g1krtyEXXeGcyplEoko"],"When":"2026-1-25"},{"Name":"Andrew Cox","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVNmspEWDXdUroLZJH5jpFcpuOquLjJpRb5HXuHcAmR-ifXZp2y=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Engaging in illegal advertising. [{"Name":"Claire Grove","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLJcV-1dfcukxkMLYyo6qg9fXLNmcc6mHdT6pCyAZHJMLuevw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"It has taken me over seven months to write this. I have tried to move on and put behind me the extremely distressing experience we had purchasing our “forever home” through Jawitz Real Estate, specifically with agent Ash Thaver. Unfortunately, the experience was so poor that I feel compelled to share it.

Key issues experienced:
1.	Upon receiving the keys, I discovered that the epoxy flooring had been repainted white due to damage caused by the previous owners moving out. This was done without our knowledge or consent.

2.	The repainting was poorly executed and extended throughout approximately 400 m² of the house. I was shocked that this was considered acceptable by the agent.

3.	The house was handed over in an unacceptable condition: toilets, baths, and floors were dusty; the kitchen was left with empty bottles; and a significant amount of the previous owner’s rubbish was left behind for us to clean.

4.	When I raised these concerns—particularly regarding the flooring—Ash Thaver became confrontational and raised his voice at me inside my own home, stating that he “didn’t need to deal with this.” I was so distressed that I had to leave the house and sit in the car crying. I have never received an apology.

5.	During attempts to resolve the flooring issue, I later became aware that Ash point blank lied saying that I had told suppliers and others that I was going to “sue him”. When I escalated these concerns to suppliers and his management (including Shawn), my concerns were effectively ignored.

6.	Within the first eight hours of living in the house, a water pipe burst. And then two days later another burst pipe. No meaningful after-sales support was provided, and we were left to manage the situation ourselves.

7.	We later discovered that the CIU had been removed by the previous owners and that the property had been converted to prepaid electricity without our knowledge. We registered directly with Eskom at our own cost and, to this day, have still not received the new CIU we paid for.

8.	We continue to experience ongoing plumbing issues. Rags were found in the drainage pipes, underground pipe fasteners have come loose, and we are now required to spend approximately R8,000 for invasive plumbing work that involves removing part of the already installed windy house structure and digging up a portion of our garden to get to the other problems under the ground.

Despite being fully aware of these issues, neither Ash Thaver nor his manager has ever contacted us to apologise or to check in on the situation.

This experience has left me deeply disappointed and resentful. We struggle to fully enjoy our home due to the ongoing stress and financial burden caused by these unresolved issues.

As an agent who walked away with a nice commission cheque he should feel some sort of embarrassment for handing over a house in this condition.! Shame!

Based on our experience, I would strongly caution others against dealing with Jawitz Real Estate, and particularly Ash Thaver.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQce8iGHjf_ffpFgagfneaf6M0O2TwIx5TPSIpYJNpbuvfb8htPKhWUMtAUmqmLpDMX5JWzNtdFfRnLRdCfoBXbnJcDMvUxKoTVe3FcP-rORYjiBBMKtNdRS1cEmaL1WDVU-UUvAHroVao","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETHNmP19-AdOJldaI3_Hd4WeZo6wpzYBMpFxUoZewl6mfiAXXt7sqcg89yOVLHIBCiAJnLwcBMnoDfZY4p26_O3rTKw8WUrUXioa1s6C1veuGJ8YlladpQTDvxa2U-TN5j8r3x0rac1R0dX","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQ0kiM1MImXFRJcyyr8B53r3IfaT06rXmo1N86UyQFq9o0OZU-qRnJf9ISu7__Ax5FmnPi3eG6btej5P4gI_ChjQL6LboZkVMc3ezsF7Iytjp_KTjhVchPcU8CyuHQxY_vEDNH74nL-z3zc","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEReONkZUd5K2-2Mb74SbhMfxFvqBvZgViKkEiajU4htClERp3kPFrLT2DHjS9lFeCGsuXolIpT1e-KR6uaWcVzrbMK4SIJQ6ZLACqEsA8_T46Qur-URQbzeogbsgy5dmf-bb1c8xCNqJZOz","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQUl3ZQ1q3UYrES_nzmJ_g5FfRjOdvTrRTJmT9r6_j9kvHtx9oxSnxMKlsuv9sIhppvJ-nqc-lk6MjNT-gOvUjxnGFXhp0Fe7S8j_baX0IVTshvXkgzOokWYJcC_os-t8nDwV9XZPiilDI","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESv4_m_WLZXxDaL89OIO4w5yalyRSgQxz2bIPmF-9-I5e2hb05xBjSzfEUUFHQq365yERSlEuSYENjdDw2_C-GbqSaCstBBNazVCLi2AedXsUSLSWciQfi0jiOa7fawQlgEleoVust36dA","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETYieyexCUBq9AInjYSZ6Qe2F0yqieSbuXjAOHZL5pUUVnvHuty76E8RFF2Ry1McToOvkLrP72JKYNNGgvWiurK3YVQ_oGbWZFwp620aEAoTJ9O4cAm9u-zJqXmrMlTaGNCKx7kb-QVZ7fn","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lER2lpabCjgpu3WjwTFsX84DVVLkm7gtoOerCDTlGmjgY8XZI6Hx4Pav_4cxZ-UfJ2NYH85WFQFy2kfKz-uBaypCslMb0TFemRIvZvxfEp0QSy4_RIc6hwjJvL_aEBWxgSeX1DfOYuf6IAsl","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERJNNB1llD2mjJbDChLG1fKGT7sBAj2NccI9jfKVfMeu40DsIIAVNMuTRb-Z6YVjb4-XhNIhYY0k3Kc4eLYQgWp40o3LKg-f1yrxHosASdIXJZno-JL6zr_7jJKlwTOYakHEAu1nefi1AHO","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESOMOWh-xfkWtLf-GM4ZRVGnpL008Z7A3oupPl_7grdbPgoDLkEkH3xyh5uyt_yFft6Q1poA6rrDnFUhQ7Igmy0XQHEzn2mwdJOwv1v1uE5nuMQuwQrC5PuG7iusqpl89wtsHjwR3PGMAtC","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com Thanks for the service Accute, see you next time ⏲️

I had the Salvation Café gourmet burger and really enjoyed it — it was juicy, meaty, and generously topped with bacon and avocado. The flavours were rich and satisfying. The overall atmosphere is chilled, but when the place fills up it can feel a little overwhelming.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sabrina Taleha","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKTYvwfWWq0QNwgwhe75fPwHJNM3YBECV6UtBXzdDe-KxwXfA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I went there for lunch with my husband, parents and my two children (1 and 5 years old). I asked for a table outside, which was very important for us because it is too noisy inside with kids and much more comfortable outside.

The manager A initially offered us a table on the terrace. I asked if I could quickly go and get my family, who were about 10 seconds away (they couldn’t wait on the stairs). When we came back, the table had been given to another family.

I said it was not a problem and that I was happy to wait. She then asked us to sit inside for a drink and said she would give us a table outside as soon as one became available. We sat inside, had our drinks, and I checked with her again, confirming that I was happy to wait if that was easier for them. Unfortunately, the outside table was once again given to another family.

In the end, my family (who I see once a year) ate without me because the baby preferred to stay outside, and I had to take my lunch away.

Unfortunately the manager was clearly the weak link in what could have been a pleasant experience. Waitress are kind and food is good.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Mighty Brown Mouse","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKGIuoP6N4PQ_e2zFBpnqnYEqrEdrV1E8AjuNUPBegdeehijQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Cafe Salvation at 44 Stanley is a great Cafe with good food, top service and beautiful ambience.

And they consistently make the best dirty chai of all the Platōs 😆

I went for one of my many visits with my puppy and they insisted on gifting him his first ever puppaccino. They didn't have to do that - but it's just such a lovely human moment.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Shannon Roos","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWep7chzyH9m1Kcy1aFMGCl5cpyvIkJq4aNxGnNk3nvMjyKgsXC=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My heart is warm from the taste of coffee beans. This morning I adventured for coffee. I am a sucker for iced coffee and I have my local spot but when they are out of stock I sit at home bummed out, but platō saved the day. I decided to try them out and see what all the hype was about. I arrived and mentioned to the server that I’ve heard great things and asked what freezo should I order. I opted for the coffee one but they were out of stock unfortunately, so the next best was the platō. I was a bit nervous but the nerves only made the experience of taste a gazillion times better. The feeling of happiness was unexplainable in this experience. The taste was so unique and perfect. The consistency was smooth and creamy, not icy at all which I loved. The espresso and sweetness complemented each other beautifully. I am so in love and so happy. This is my new favorite alternative coffee spot and I can’t wait to be back. I love the ambience and feeling when walking into this place as it’s so aesthetically clean.
Just to add, I appreciate the sweet messages they write on their cups. The message goes a long way and makes the experience better. “Queen stay fab”.
Their custard cube croissant 🥐 is to die for! So light and the filling is subtly sweet and smooth, perfect pairing with my coffee.
I tried matcha 🍵 for the first time from Plato and I fell in love with it (you either love it or you hate it). It was so creamy and earthy with the nuttiness from the macadamia milk. I love that you can now add protein to your drink! The Caribbean adds nice flavour to the matcha as it adds a coconut hint.

Absolutely love platō and the staff always greet with a smile!","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lET3pBbUQQDV5BTCD36CZOpY49Gu6RAJz2dlPjZtqVVlk_hDuJipdqukD0YipJFquLj7eAqt8XF4pL4A7SLTx4EW70xJ2-ojB2DnIX539riNg06l05UjBvDcNL20iyJccN_GTUHb","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQWr25avl8RNCg9BHbv-B7Rkkc5EtziG8qLSKGIvTRB4kv4JHdKDGG7APrkXgH_drCP4Vl5JQ9vqb7SG4CQTw2NoWuQF-gd1uSX7ZRedpUArnJC-8OSheCM_B2Ec7T8sPRwSNvw","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETkArDRxhx5SB9xSdsEhLllGyUaO6BJwuzy25kXCgujkITMlzL8AGV-veRCY3DOoF3nbIreWjhQ3o0IQ1pVkBeDCUDG_o2QEKD3qcB5d12aFac4ZLWtrHPTj_h2vUXDaiyQ2qamgw","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lET38xtPh7F4-pQKSoO6h4J1VBFweSnfMsOzNCdjlXPqf3V48RzipcYDNppU4wg7VnjMn9mEg84BnyrWTQZ9LzRwCyHR3XYoez7hrqRhVTTL8jklOsZu7iFz86ogQ5ZadMCybKc","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETRkD5y97ksqPE5tk4oygPAh3AEzOhjVrVPoecd3TpRjn8PiAnBy-TZ3mtCFBKqRzpbZ5N6CDR3rGd0Y18JRp48c3LMVMDzay_Ykeyy8HfuPA0jL4AcEuFBjAy-2XIH3FhxOiiYmA","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETSIEVcpLQDP42nt5eIQ0maoFrpcNZ6HmhbpzGfJ86q4uv3sD28CIBEmnr8E0t0kiYjqmfLEFtHeK5uFjuygAeEioN6BX_Qmd-GLMargXxK1eQ-eXGA8BHcqclDjVQegpd4bNNk"],"When":"2024-3-21"},{"Name":"Jane Doe","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXrlMEN7sAaxT17Srtc_H4kx2oYKbOXFYp_hJHsroKfef_3sWY=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"The coffee is decent but for that price the service definitely needs to improve. I was also a bit disappointed that the waffles were only bubble waffles and not like regular waffles because i really wanted to try one but wasn't feeling for a waffle in a cup.

The Creamed Spinach on the side was a good call—rich, creamy, and exactly what you’d expect from a traditional grillhouse.

The chicken ballotine was well presented and enjoyable overall. The truffle and spinach velouté were flavorful and paired nicely with the brioche. However, some pieces of the chicken were slightly dry, which took away from the richness of the dish. The accompanying green beans could use a bit more seasoning or butter to enhance their flavor and texture. This small change would make a noticeable improvement.

The vegan chocolate dessert was the highlight of the meal. The combination of dark chocolate, raspberry, and almond was well balanced and indulgent without being overly sweet. It was a lovely way to end the meal.

Service was professional and attentive, exactly as expected from a restaurant of this standard. At first glance, the setting suggests a fine dining experience, complete with an extensive international wine list. However, the ambiance tells a different story—unexpectedly loud and bustling, which detracted from the sophisticated atmosphere we were hoping for.

We started with a sushi platter, which was fresh and well-prepared—an enjoyable introduction. For mains, we each chose different steak dishes, which were the highlight of the evening: well-cooked and accompanied by interesting vegetable sides. Unfortunately, the ribs we ordered were underwhelming—plain in flavour and not reflective of their premium price.

The biggest disappointment was the overall experience. While the presentation and wine selection impressed, the high noise levels, inconsistent dish quality, and steep pricing (expect to pay over R1,200 per person, with wine starting around R1,000 per bottle) left us feeling underwhelmed. At that price point, we expected an exceptional and memorable evening—something Signature didn’t deliver.

Verdict: Stylish but noisy, pricey without delivering consistent value. We won’t be My starters were Oysters (I dont like oysters when I'm too far from the coast) but these did not disappoint. The oysters were fresh definetly value for money. I also had the beef tongue, it was so soft and delectable, I had to have seconds! Compliments to Chef Thabo.
For mains I had Cream Beef Pasta, the beef was also tender and my partner had surf and turf which is prawns and beef. The food was amazing.

The restaurant is divided into 2, an indoor dining area and outside sitting area. Outdoors you can catch live tv matches, listen to music, mingle and smoke hubbly too! Indoors, is quiet and very cosy.

From the moment we arrived, Nomusa, the hostess, greeted us with her signature warmth. It makes such a difference when a restaurant doesn't just see you as a table number, but treats you like family—the staff here know my twins so well and always make them feel incredibly special.

The food was, as expected, world-class:
• Starters: The Dim Sum and Edamame Beans were the perfect light, high-protein start to the meal.
• Mains: My Fillet was cooked to absolute perfection—lean, tender, and exactly what I needed after a week of intense training. The Barramundi was equally impressive, fresh and beautifully prepared.
• Dessert: We couldn't resist finishing off with the Chocolate Jar, which is a legendary treat for a reason!

A massive thank you to Mercy, our waitress, for her impeccable and attentive service, and to the manager, Dylan, for consistently running such a tight, welcoming ship.

The restaurant was not to busy at all but I'd still recommend making a booking in advance so you ensure you have a table when you arrive.

They have meals which are called the Pablo Signature and served 24/7 which is nice. They include some breakfast options.

I chose to have a cappuccino while I made my decision for lunch. They did not have Chai so those options were excluded. The cappuccino was quite nice and the coffee was fairly strong which is good. The presentation was a bit sloppy as coffee was spilled on the side upon arrival.

For the meal I had the smoke salmon eggs Benedict. I requested the eggs to be poached medium well and they were. The food tasted really good but the wait was longer than I prefer. It was closer to the 30 minutes from order to arrival.

The atmosphere was quite good and lively for a Sunday morning. [{"Name":"Patrick Claassens","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXMoMfDORY08qHv2QvrjK_iPAOENlRm-Ktf8Mz8LLi0p5mnQrdR=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We went for a small snack here before going to see a show at the Nelson Mandela Square Theatre, and it was a great decision.

If you sit next to the windows you have a great view of the entire Nelson Mandela Square and during festive times, at night, this is a truly great spot to be seated at.

The food is fantastic and the atmosphere is extremely lively. It feels like a penthouse luxury party. Everything was of quality and very clean. Service was great, we never felt rushed nor did we have to wait to get help.

The menu is quite extensive, but not too big to overwhelm you. It is mainly asian cuisine but you can get some other types of cuisine as well.

If you ever come to Tang, I HIGHLY recommend the sorbet dessert. These were the most fragrant and strong tasting sorbets I have ever eaten, while being so light that you could eat all of them.

The sticky sauce that I had with my fried chicken was  extremely flavourful. The chocolate cake was rich and the sauce that came with it even richer, definitely a sweet tooth’s dessert pick at Tang.

[{"Name":"Emma Paul","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUpISp8VPsZyTicKvDFIekCZimmGZrPTnSieECIPTYa3_fDFU83=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"La Parade is a beautifully decorated spot with a lively atmosphere, perfect for catching up with friends or simply soaking in the vibe. It was incredibly busy when I arrived, and although I was seated right away, the table hadn’t been cleaned. I waited about 40 minutes before anyone attended to me, which was a bit disappointing. With no other plans for the day, I just settled in and people-watched until the manager stepped in to check on the table next to mine and kindly acknowledged me as well. That’s when things turned around,my table was cleaned, I placed my drink order, and service finally picked up. Once the food arrived, it definitely delivered. I’d rate it a solid 7/10. The cauliflower bites were the standout, crispy, flavorful, and something I’d order again without hesitation.
Overall, I would return to La Parade for the ambiance and food, but next time I’d go on a weekday or make a reservation to avoid the wait. It has great potential, just requires a little patience on a busy The food was absolutely delicious and the service impeccable.

I was staying at the hotel and with that ate there two nights in a row. The second night, the waiter welcomed me back and even asked if I wanted to sit where I was the previous day, pointing at my table from the previous night. He wasn’t even my waiter the previous night so the fact that he remembered was quite amazing.

They have tables outside on Maude street yet despite how busy the street can be, it still felt secluded and cozy enough. Inside you have beautiful spaces to sit. The one area in particular intrigued me where it looked like the table top was resting on books. Unfortunately there were people seated there so I couldn’t take photos.

For my first night I had an amazing strawberry daiquiri and crumbed hot honey chicken with a huge baked potato and sour cream.

My second night I had a refreshing Stella and their sundried tomato and butternut risotto with toasted pine nuts.

Every bite was a treat. Definitely my go to when I travel again.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETaEe1NEtt3ktcXXOlHKSPbQ0FklkOdyZUDWz6s8_sfeKJ180gqa_4AC0Dhgjyr0RnCCKmOepyTE5GznVdI6LO3pnY71RwOLjSODwDK7yHOg9SfxNNSF2HWky1UEKadYRwOKame1P8hRiX_","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERpHxDbFFgVfj_gTrxeD94eVHTr6wx4vPiGQzJu6SNeY2bnSc53Xs3lUx7NDcrQ9P7dTeIyoqc2TSXHxH8_OBbESSbwem-qpvyxFgoAH25FihSI_vP1Blqtf4HJA4C3wlbL3Nds-IpEOZ_W","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESWThhhL_FJ8JkPicHjHATy1HqsN5SxMuT2Ufdz_WwqsGcyFMBTOpcNozVOLLmM7ZfVxz5pMS-WhQW9Le-jE1OcC2HiMhZC4KzSB2aSMdSMSK5HJ6FDnHDcjnbDT4Nyy7IyNUlAkxlDrf3v","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETQBRcLn7a1zBmfUs8Nh8d1ep7_RV9MxS-9fckRCXXqxpmJFGohFPOYZzkdL110tTTGKVo1l9yPy9FFZwjM9Edi_-JpMI9VkZvd06CkzQ4Ce51z-6Tvk11ZOF7rpBJ6jBHDruflocEtmIlY"],"When":"2025-10-5"},{"Name":"Kathie Nunley","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV_4qiOWNg6weFvYAKXQiT6nfpVKvKsHBwLJ_-8dbdYx_z78Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Absolutely amazing steak. The food is an easy 10/10—compliments to the kitchen staff for delivering dishes that are full of flavor, thoughtfully prepared, and genuinely memorable. Every plate reflected care, skill, and consistency.

My experience already started off on the bad foot when despite booking on the day the restaurant phoned me to confirm the booking on a shockingly bad telephone line that you can barely hear a thing. If a person books on the same day, there is zero reason to annoy them by phoning them. Especially on a Tuesday night when your restaurant is not busy.

The lead up to the restaurant is very dark and with many steps to navigate. The temperature is also freezing in the restaurant so make sure you have a jersey or a jacket.

I wanted to order a cocktail but was told it was out of stock.

We were served complimentary bread, olive oil & balsamic & olives. The tremogos mentioned on the menu was missing. The waitress plonked it down without saying anything. While I had bread on my plate the waitress already attempted to take it away.

Drinks were set down without really making space. You had to open and pour your own drink. The cans and straw wrappers were left on the table the entire meal until the manager noticed and took them away. The dirty side plates from the bread were never taken away until we asked them to.

The main courses are very expensive and do not come with any sides.

I had the calamari which was supposed to come with a sauce of your choice. The waitress charged me extra R45 for the sauce despite it being included on the menu. We then had to have them check to have it removed.

The calamari was a bit oily and didn’t have much taste. The peri peri sauce was sour. This meal left me feeling slightly unwell.

My friend had the chicken prego which is rather expensive for R220 (chips not included). Might as well go to Nandos.

I asked for a takeaway and that was forgotten. The wine list does not have many wine by the glass options. You cannot have a Chenin blanc by the glass.

To spend R500 for calamari, chips, coke and a shared bottle of water is absolutely ridiculous.
This is probably better suited for hotel guests who would expect to pay above average prices for a below average experience.

I do not recommend at all & would not return. Check your bill carefully if you decide to ignore this warning as you will probably be overcharged due to their incompetence.

Apparently as stated by the business if the manager walks you out that should make for a lovely experience. I must have also missed the part where anyone apologised for overcharging. I had no issues with your manager but your WAITRESS.

When you watched the video did you notice how things weren’t cleaned away from our table? I love how you haven’t actually responded to any of my other feedback aside from phone calls and pricing.

Also maybe you should update all your incorrect menus on Instagram as well as on your website. And yes even though it so clearly states a sauce is included your waitress couldn’t admit the fault and still insisted that I ordered it separately.

So just to summarise because I didn’t mention this to your manager who did not ask me, I made up this whole experience in my head?

You clearly don’t appreciate any feedback and probably will not do anything to train your servers better. The ribs were okay, it was a bit of a fight to get the meat off the bone, which I think shouldn't be the case anytime ribs are involved. I'm not saying it should fall of the bone, but it shouldn't be chewy/dry.

We celebrated my daughter birthday there, and the team made it truly unforgettable. Even with the rain pouring down outside, the atmosphere inside stayed warm, homely, and full of vibrance — nothing could dampen the mood.
Every corner of the space feels exciting and unique, and the attention to detail is obvious. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the menu is fresh, creative, and packed with amazing options. You can really feel the passion behind everything they do.
The cherry on top of the entire evening was getting to meet J-Something himself! He took the time to come over, say hello, and personally wish her a happy birthday — such a genuine and special touch.
If you’re looking for a place that blends great food, incredible ambience, and authentic hospitality, The Artistry is definitely worth a visit. We’ll absolutely be back!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Tamryn Smith","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVTlS1KW2mwRBDa2gHIJtV96cywMA7l4SB2R1g_vkBoonTOzXqUgg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"We had the most incredible time here! From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the beautiful aesthetic of the place — it’s absolutely stunning, and the view during sunset made it even more magical. The music added such a great vibe to the evening, perfectly setting the mood.

The food was not only delicious but also really affordable. I had the deep-fried mac and cheese, which was crispy and flavourful
without being oily (a rare find!), and my boyfriend had a medium rare steak that was cooked to absolute perfection.

At 5:10pm on the day of our reservation, we received a call asking to move our booking to 6:30pm due to a function. While this was inconvenient, we agreed after being told the situation would be made up to us.

Unfortunately, that was not the case.

Upon arrival, there was confusion at the entrance before we were eventually shown to our table. There was a puddle of water directly behind my chair, and a fly hovering around our table. When we received our menus, one had visible food stuck to it. I had to request a clean menu, which is not something any guest should have to do.

When ordering drinks, I asked for a fruit juice for my partner, and before I could place my own order, the waiter walked away, requiring us to wait again for service.

While the food itself was excellent, the service and overall attention to detail fell well below expectations — especially after we had accommodated a last-minute change to our booking on the assurance that it would be handled properly and considering the price we really expected better.

My family and I are regular patrons, which makes this experience particularly disappointing. There should be a much higher standard of professionalism and service, and on this occasion, it simply was not delivered.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Frotty Sirewu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXMpHgVYOOisPixvnFYncRssUW6o_0oEghq-f7gUDNyDUcBTWhn=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Our visit to Gaucho was outstanding, and Jabu was exceptional. He was welcoming, knowledgeable about the menu, and gave great recommendations. He was attentive to every detail and ensured we had everything we needed. His positive attitude and professionalism really stood out. We’ll definitely be back!”
The manager on duty was Candel (sp),very friendly and welcoming.

Highly recommend.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Olivia","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXxx2vBUmI2zz2zgX5uKRLvfgznFlx-gESiK6K7DiPlPyjfHbKXJQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I visited Gaucho after seeing great reviews, but my experience didn’t match them. The location is lovely, but the seating is impractical — the chairs are so low that I had to lean forward the whole time, which was uncomfortable.

The chicken taco sharing platter was excellent and honestly the best part of the meal.

The problems started with the mains. My chicken espetada was burnt, and the taste was so strong it made me cough repeatedly. I tried to push through, but I eventually had to speak up. My partner’s cheeseburger was extremely oily, and he didn’t want to finish it — and he loves burgers, so that says a lot. The chips also had odd seasoning and were oily.

Although they replaced my espetada, the staff’s behavior after that was the worst part. I’ve never had people look at me that way just for politely mentioning an issue. It made us so uncomfortable that we asked for a takeaway bag and decided to leave.

The manager did speak to us, but it didn’t feel very genuine or helpful.

Overall, I really hoped for a great experience, especially for the price, but it just wasn’t what we expected.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Keagan Blunden","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWqylKB9_q_8-HLi12fb2obAyrn3exdGG8AxBmSJ-FK_--CT-5-rA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"The softest, most juiciest, most tender fillet I have had in a loooooong time. Each plate is a testament to the dedication of the chef, who pour their heart and soul into creating a homemade quality that resonates deeply with diners.

In a world where dining options can often feel generic or mass-produced, Savour & Sage stands out as a hidden treasure. Since I was a child, our family has been buying sputniks and fish cakes from Nono’s, and those memories are still so vivid today.
I remember the mother and father who started the bakery. Although the father passed away many years ago, the mother built the bakery into what it is today, strong, consistent, and still standing proudly. There is something incredibly special about a family business that keeps its heart and traditions alive for generations.
Even though I now live in Helderkruin, our family still drives all the way to Nono’s. The bakery has not changed a bit, and that’s exactly why we keep coming back.
To this day, Nono’s is the only bakery I know that makes cream doughnuts filled with real, fresh cream, not substitutes, not shortcuts, just the real thing.
Nono’s isn’t just a bakery; it’s part of our family history. I was specifically there to buy petit fours and tarts. In hindsight, I should have asked when the items were made, as the freshness was inconsistent. [{"Name":"Yousuf Pandor","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWsZ7MYEWrp9mFuzlnl-SBFFY2rKwIw8_YWMGgucI426M7MYHfQQA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I had an unpleasant experience at La Bakery Ormonde.
We visited the store to buy sweets and savouries. While we were inside, our 10-month-old baby accidentally pulled a tub of biscuits from the shelf, causing four tubs to fall onto the floor. The biscuits spilled out, and we picked them up ourselves and placed them back into the tubs, cleaning up the mess as best as we could.
We looked around for assistance, but no one came to help us. A staff member was standing nearby and observing the situation, but she did not approach us or offer any help. After we had finished cleaning, we approached her and explained what had happened. She shook her head and told us that if we did not pay for the biscuits, the staff would have to cover the expense, and that we would therefore need to pay for them.
When we went to the till, we were informed that this staff member was the supervisor. Our bill came to just under R500, largely due to the cost of the broken tub of biscuits. As a result, we were only able to purchase one of the items we had originally intended to buy, as most of the payment went towards the biscuits.
What was most disappointing was that the supervisor never approached us during the incident. She simply stood and watched, offering no assistance, empathy, or customer care. Her attitude was unpleasant and unhelpful.
This experience left us feeling uncomfortable and disappointed, and it is unlikely that we will return after such service.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Zain Naidoo","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIfY51SGmJAnfPJ3ZOpvx_dsLGTs7LBttYl13wUGviefIhh-Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Some of the best baked goods in all of JHB. The food and service used to be excellent, in fact, the owner would sometimes offer complimentary pieces of cake as a kind gesture to frequent customers, which I always appreciated.

Unfortunately, I’ve noticed a decline in both food quality and service over recent visits. On one occasion, I even paid in full but left the food unfinished.

Today, I stopped by for my usual cappuccino, but the foam appeared off. I mentioned it politely, suggesting it might be an issue with the milk or the machine, and simply expected a replacement made to the usual standard. Instead, the manager came over and implied the problem was because I had left the coffee too long, despite the fact it had only just been served.

I was quite taken aback to be blamed rather than having any effort made to resolve the issue. For context, I always order two cappuccinos during my visits, so I’m very familiar with how they’re normally prepared.

Given the manager’s attitude and the overall decline in quality, I regret to say I won’t be returning. I wanted to share this feedback in the hope that it’s taken constructively, as this used to be one of my favourite places.","Images":null,"When":""}]

A Haven for Book Lovers and Foodies Alike

Service 5☆
Atmosphere 5☆
Food 5☆

I recently had the pleasure of visiting the Library Cafe, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. This charming cafe seamlessly combines a love for literature with a passion for culinary delights, creating a unique and captivating atmosphere.

●Service:
The service was outstanding, with friendly and attentive staff who went above and beyond to ensure a pleasant experience. Our server was knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations and checking in regularly to refill drinks and clear plates.

●Atmosphere:
The atmosphere was amazing, with comfortable seating areas and plenty of natural light pouring in through the large windows. The library-inspired decor added a touch of sophistication, making it an ideal spot for a quiet lunch or coffee date.

●Food:
The culinary offerings were truly impressive, with each dish showcasing the chef's attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality ingredients.

●Kentucky Burger and Chips:
The burger was cooked to perfection, with a juicy patty, crispy bacon, and melted cheddar cheese, all sandwiched between a toasted brioche bun. The chips were crispy and flavorful, making for a satisfying side dish.

●Seared Salmon with Asparagus and Herb Mash:
The salmon was seared to a perfect medium-rare, with a delicate crust giving way to tender, flaky flesh. The asparagus was cooked just right, and the herb mash added a subtle yet aromatic flavor.

●Medium Rare Rump Steak with Chips and Mushroom Sauce:
The steak was cooked to a perfect medium-rare, with a rich, beefy flavor and tender texture. The mushroom sauce added an earthy depth, while the chips provided a satisfying crunch.

●Mini Tarts:
These bite-sized treats were the perfect ending to our meal, with a flaky pastry crust giving way to a sweet and tangy filling.

[{"Name":"Kaveshnee John","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK18lM--a3VRO37WBwrCHqyLnVbjEwDwTx5D8lEE3QgWdDlAA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"If I could give more than 5 stars I would!

Old Ducky is a beautifully cozy restaurant that delivers both charm and quality. Our waiter was exceptionally attentive, checking in regularly even though we were too busy catching up to look at the menu at first — a small gesture that made a big difference.

I started with a refreshing pressed apple and pineapple juice, which was the perfect palate cleanser before our meal. The prawn shooters were absolutely divine — fresh, succulent prawns served in a creamy tomato sauce that was full of flavor. The standout dish for me, however, was the mussels. They were among the best I’ve had in a long time, cooked to perfection and served in a light, creamy garlic sauce that kept you going back for more.

We shared the mussels and calamari as our main dishes, both of which were generously portioned and beautifully presented. The chef even surprised us with an amuse-bouche, a thoughtful touch that elevated the experience further.

Overall, Old Ducky left a lasting impression — not only for its excellent food but also for the way we were treated. It felt like more than just dining out; it was an experience where guests are genuinely valued. When dining at some of these restaurants we don’t only look at service and ambience we also consider the quality of food presented and prepared.
Here’s what we ordered:
Paneer Pav Bhaji Dosa
Cauliflower chickpeas and potato
Paneer Jalfrezi
Chicken tikka masala
Prawn madras
Garlic naan
Steamed basmati rice
Carrot halva

Pros: ambience, service and music was great.
-Paneer Pav Bhaji Dosa
-Cauliflower chickpeas and potato
-Carrot halva
These were about the best tasting dishes out of everything we ordered. The latter being a dessert.

Cons:
The prawn madras was a very watered down chutney and not an authentic madras dish with the spices you would expect.
Chicken tikka masala was average and tasted of a store bought paste thrown in, again not tasting of tikka masala flavours at all.
The paneer jalfrezi was a watery chutney and lacked that hearty consistency you find at other restaurants locally and abroad.

The cost of each dish is higher compared to other restaurants locally and considering that factor they don’t provide rice with each dish. Most other Indian restaurants do provide rice and their portions sizes are larger in comparison to Modern Tailors.

Total bill with drinks : R1800

Just based on food, rating: 2/5","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESpxO740AyHFKN30CyLDYtH4LipAhlwW1bWW-bI13KQ5JHxAaTFDhZfN0uew8oIiLFeE6DzDB2JQk2PI481npmbe-IJRNca6E-w3wMHASxklX_KpdwsGzL6rqCub6zN6C8K5-fPmSoPUqPI","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERrKHE0ZktXQynA5Xy5puuEwapUa6Ka9WaLrlW2dte4h80XsWO8jI-xQbSCizZlF9dYze3_-X2-6JbARqnwg2CHc0uSP8cUysw5eM9Xi4f0uH-tq-5eufch84SRZ2jxM6MVyyIJHLUpeA8"],"When":"2026-1-25"},{"Name":"Silvia Strangis","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVs_UzHxdnffm8UTyYGdSmryQ1z4A5t4LIrjaO25j5uRe2LsLvg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"Overall a good experience, the service was impeccable and the restaurant is wonderfully designed.
