[{"Name":"Kat","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK4AmQq410PNOecovRu-U3ys_27Qti_rF6HHgVe7ovjdi9FgQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Went here off the back of a recommendation from friends and it did not disappoint!

From the minute we arrived (and we arrived quite late), all the staff were super helpful and accommodating and let us know that we would need to order quickly due to the kitchen closing. We were kept well informed and looked after from the start.

The waiter we had was amazing, super knowledgable and attentive. We went for the wagyu sirloin steaks and they were probably one of the best we’ve ever had. Spicy margaritas were delicious, Pinotage from Stellenbosch was amazing and the value for money was incredible given the quality.

I loved that you could order a steak which already came won’t some green veg (beans and tender stem) as well as some fries. Also loved how there are cheaper options that are still incredible - eg the sirloin. You don’t have to compromise on price for quality! I don’t know what they put on their fries but they were like crack!

Delicious all round and will 100% be back. After trying many places in Joburg this is definitely one of the best - and many of the tables around us were regular customers - so that speaks for itself! A must try!","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERjowLXzBV9JCvOgra0WjyEwAdj8ahNmwEfZO5M9NFS5X0N6i8TrbxNgnj9xHdfEBHWcEjiuzwwdTu5qkOl4iNJfC_AkiLgvkwCOu2Itcj8Eopdf0uT4_ihL7JhCM4JvkvT1oYNlPHF0tI","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQ6lPaiKTA1Bgqf20E8l4V9nil9fshByf8XN13uOZ1Lqu4FzWSsLEIHSxNQFu2kx5UFQnA8WV95IhNfGQISrd2rLz_gInP2f8JdTisI78YcrP4QjZ5zJxY82Zv88F-Ikq-5VV6X3JdFsPL4"],"When":"2025-12-18"},{"Name":"Faye Liwanag-Naidoo","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUswuaEVPe9li88pp4g5qVzqPYQI0V9IlMNYsSSmsUlc6kyhyJl=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My husband took me here for my birthday and what an experience. It was beautiful - we were led to our seats and given bread and pita with butter and butternut. For drinks we had cocktails and water.

For starters, we had the octopus and chorizo - super recommend this. It tasted soo good and the octopus was soft and had a great taste to it. For mains we had steaks and both were cooked to perfection, it melts in your mouth, just couldnt get enough of it. One of the best steaks I had in a long time. No doubt attracted to meetings by the excellent acoustics in the Proud Mary venue. Again, I know it to be an intended outcome by the developers. Their philosophy seemed to be a deliberate intention to impact the immediate environs of the development. This required painful pleadings to convince the Stone Age mindset of the likes of Old Mutual Properties, to the benefit of improving security, cleanliness and the creation of landscaped walkways which immediately led to an enhanced precinct experience. This, ultimately, has lifted the value of their own portfolios. Testimony to this is the number of families who take advantage of the amenities, especially over the weekends. Having just spent time in Seapoint where developers have erected monstrosities with no positive impact on their immediate environment, is a case in point. Despite the millions invested, Seapoint remains a seedy island populated by incredible developments, sex shops, vagrants, drug dealers and coffee shops of varying degrees of hygiene. Surely the council (one of the few still functioning in SA) should impose and coordinate a general upliftment obligation on these developers to positively impact beyond there selfish projects? Proud South African-Italian here. My heart is singing, my stomach is dancing and my feet are tapping the floor. The pizza God’s answered my prayers. If you are looking for real authentic pizza that tastes like you’re in Naples-Italy, this is the spot. I am blown away!
First off this place is so sweet and warm. The staff are so friendly and bubbly, and you can see they love what they do. They are so accommodating and attentive making sure everything is okay.
The menu is simple but makes it perfection.
Words can’t even articulate how beautiful this pizza was. As someone who is passionate about the culinary world, I was in my element. Napz has truly mastered the authenticity in their dough with the combination of using simple but high quality ingredients. You’ve never tasted anything more pure than this. The pizza articulates history, Italian culture and recipes that have carried out for centuries. Nonna would be proud.
My mom & I had the classic margherita, and this was heaven on a plate. Dough cooked perfectly, exceptional fermentation, chewy but soft crust. The Napolitana sauce was acidic, sweet and combined exceptionally with the fior di latte & pecorino romano giving a nice cheese kick, basil for herbaceous notes and olive oil for that final touch
Napz you are a blessing & made my Friday night special, keep up the amazing work. Bene Grazie!","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESVK-jr1f5zJNCMBUIsw48S8LkeGlyGDJg5RUhyr-7H25JLhIlZ9XzcvArJPpEmpWmeQK3z1nOgwBvk-GN8vEJCgKQZDYQmKrJjK1Kd696UnwsJKy7RvR-ojiuuSluR4nYqIv1_et5YgBU","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERLw3_UdCGjrLON758p6cNefqZfpVGsBBF7kO43IzYug1bS5WpqvPthNkoAZIgnB46n8w3T7u0agUneBkmOqt4bk-n9rNb3n5LvMeeydQDeViEdloxk1he5jFvNdzKaRZOymxQ0rbqKrwE"],"When":"2025-7-25"},{"Name":"Stefan Venkov","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWVizsU05LdKCa7gwugzlaKYDT3HvQnukdDsKSgtKkO90XL4vs=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Best Pizza in the SA!!🔥🔥🔥

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Authentic Italian Pizza Perfection!

From the moment we walked in, we knew we were in for something special. This place doesn’t just serve pizza—it serves an experience. The aroma of freshly baked dough, bubbling cheese, and rich tomato sauce hits you immediately, and it only gets better from there.

We ordered the Margherita and it was absolute perfection. The crust , crisp, and beautifully blistered from the authentic italian oven—exactly how it should be. You can taste the quality in every bite—the special tomato sauce, the fresh mozzarella, the drizzle of olive oil—bellissimo!

The service was warm and welcoming, just like you'd expect from a family-run trattoria in Naples. The staff clearly takes pride in what they do, and it shows in both the food and the atmosphere.

Whether you're a pizza purist or looking to explore bold, authentic flavors, this spot is an absolute must-visit. Hands down, the best Italian pizza I’ve had outside of Italy. When she got home my stop mom would then cook the fish for lunch. Seafood was never refrigerated or frozen. It was always fresh catch of the day. So I know what fresh fish tastes like.

Before heading to the airport on our last day in South Africa, I’m so happy to we were able to eat in Fishmonger Rosebank.

We told the waiter Frederick that we had to leave by a certain time to check out of our hotel and he made sure to serve us quickly and efficiently with so much attention to details. We really appreciated it! We felt spoiled!

It’s very rare for me to be served fish with a fish knife but it seems to be what’s done in South Africa. I usually do it at home as a diplowifr. These little details really help a meal Stand out.

The bread looked like giant lips. It was nice and crusty on the outside yet soft and airy inside. Very yummy with butter.

When the food came, we were in food heaven! Perfectly cooked and seasoned.  For 2 adults and 1 child the following was just right:

- 9pcs grilled Mozambique Queen Prawns + French fries with cheese on top for sides
- grilled Kingklip + French fries with cheese on top for sides (this is a local fish and it was perfectly flaky!)

Even if we didn’t order dessert, Frederick gave us a sweet end to our meal with delicious strawberry ice cream - my son and husband’s favorite!

If you love fresh seafood, I highly recommend Johannesburg.  Rosebank

This restaurant is located in a shopping mall in Rosebank. My husband and I are seafood fanatics, and this is the best restaurant in the area offering fresh seafood.

Food:
They have a pretty big selection of seafood, as well as meat, poultry, and sushi. We stuck with the seafood and our favorites were the grilled lobster - so fresh and tender. The langoustines were perfectly cooked on the grill with garlic butter – so flavorful. You get to pick a side for your seafood. I'm partial to their green salad - fresh veggies and creamy avocado. Yum.

We also tried the fried calamari, which was soft and not rubbery at all. The mussels in white wine sauce were amazing too. No complaints about any of the dishes.

Service:
The service was excellent. All the waiters were super nice. We went there a few days in a row and they were always happy to see us. They cleared the dirty plates quickly, and the waiters were always around to help.

Overall:

We highly recommend this restaurant to any seafood lovers. Fresh, well-cooked, and the best place to find fresh fish and seafood in Rosebank.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQKWeP2yAHnLNKbASp4urfnoyBS0_xsygZPvf772qF9iYg54oiCHFE51TatDSCiDUC8j2YBt5tPHD6OArkENsVv-osXdyWBKTvUi2pU2YaCG8PfU9381CBpbPK5cy6vQWax-cjc","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETS0AU-Wp4qi4cBBDBdUQZRr8K6na0oXYvLZlPeFj8LNokqb4nxwMa3aPkQ2K3is5eYpns_ejQZ5HwQGlRODtpmf0iMB73xUfxzj3cCRDMGrme_vCU-ZMrvd9X8LLxqVaPccFl_","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEShozJrHfkDRIQkwJ6hLzXPaaFAZhV2xe-B-411spiX5osAayDeVG5lg7dwG8CCohe-_gxywSN66SQVg1RYWUfuVEo8QSbPgdkgKavBO4ZFTOLxpTnebenPOyScfEkRzlI_beI-","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERSlUgTuS1SBkp93Ry4H6_3AGfqmgelkTWYv-oe6KEQB32ExnhVc9gxWyJzea7nxWamx1PfnAJuYtutVdS8huzVDvwsOn4WKLSJ3evBBhbnLnFUkgQia7YabkPd3wMxdYJ3s-h9NA","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESpInLoPTQQlRhduIkKJiPic1yHD_EQMtx9Y7ey2Rt9CENS9O2sVYqctcuYvogAmtZOTeAhjv3menloyi2osSu2rDv5PGYX1ksyCrydeAA_eZFvfJuOKEW3TKs-wV0PPVWNFNU","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQIhCibme8fS4GOP-T4mlDYB6zJ-EEnbVsah1q1JNQ_GvqbKCNnbFlqCql7nM-9g1ZRaQ63mAJN_1qhob602e189JzKqaDa4F1Zj7YD7owYBxYkl9Ax4O2G6JbYnSbPm5sTcNwKvQ","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQYilICk3s0MXJrz-Bt2xjaBJyQBGiuHjC8fa657cC-b1aR2WFum7H1UbuxYniufDbYNXZVhcsHgM3MBxWdKqWIDR2Hwl8E5sra4EyjGJUKOSBkFu_ihvyMroV0X_RiZ9qYCmQ"],"When":"2024-6-21"},{"Name":"Tsholofelo Wechoemang","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVqV3OH9pQzpzR9nCnrPcZ9o24DRkA1bWbKwcYZDWV1IUshC3w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"What an absolute delight. Each course was generous in portion and soul. The duck main stood out as the highlight—tender and rich, balanced by cabbage and pumpkin that stirred a deep nostalgia. It reminded us of simpler times and flavours from childhood, but reimagined through the lens of fine dining.

Dessert was a masterpiece—not just in taste but in sentiment. A hidden surprise element made it more than just a dish; it became a shared moment, especially for my partner, who was visibly touched.

And then, there was Lerato—our waiter and the true heart of the evening. His grace, timing, and genuine warmth tied everything together seamlessly.

This meal didn’t just satisfy; it stayed with us. A perfect blend of past and present—familiar flavours, new memories. They have the look and feel going without the touch. The hotel room was not as clean as the swipe of my bank card. The decorative pillows on the bed smelled of the previous guest/s. They were not generous with the showered gels and a lot of other little trinkets which for the price should be a none issue.

They have a bar located close to the rooms,  the music is too damn loud. They don't really have amenities. It seems their main business comes from conference facilities.

The restaurant is not impresive, it feels like it was simply dated off as a bar and turned into an eating space. The food was impressive on the first night until I ordered lamb the next night and it tasted a 100% like my oxtail from the night before. This clearly said "prepacked catering". I was so disappointed.

The bathroom in the hotel room was one step down from the room level, my wife strained her ankle and it set her back from on from recovery by two weeks following that. It happened on the first night and arrival, imagine that. Why would you not consider basic safety when building a "high end" hotel?

The place over promises but under deliveries over all. It's such a shame because it has potential but at the end of stay, I felt like I had gone somewhere to simply stay in a room. I didn't walk away with an experience or a sense of value for money.

Seeing as there's a club at the back, don't know they need a DJ in the restaurant too.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lES-If8ptRdao8bIC69UVsjbfQijfUcPTm2eOy41VExhDHrhXKereFzM7Gr0V5nOx5cziVGHNXXzzEUhUYd2PTXwQdLB84iDwk72Ipxo5BEy0ewLi5phNvhKY34G15ksBvFERY7eUj-6KCrJ"],"When":"2026-2-14"},{"Name":"Mark Venter","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocL6IzfHDuGgwsiAfdNoZLbMRxAtEGXcVCd8hAgoAafbaCUfoA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"First timer, 50% off cocktails Thursday evening, great food, great service, they had 80s music out in front to set the vibe while we ate, and at eight o'clock there's a surprise, im not going to ruin it, go see, go experience and leave your phone at home.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Darryl Kruger","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU4d28Ra-NWQsUY1R2NF2ga4RO1J7idnus1ULxDSCtUiJEjIkE=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This restaurant is simply one of our new Favourites! we had such a good evening!
our waitress Rose was so amazing, attentive and just a gem.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Matthew Augustine","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK3pgna1QpvUep6bnJChYwQ1_KGS-AHRtkQqrJYGV4U8kWC0g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Dear Google Community, I wish to share my quite frankly disappointing experience at the Naked Woolf. My wife booked for a party of 10 towards the end of January and she spent a fair amount of money for an evening that was just completely lackluster.

Everything we had seen and heard prior to our arrival was very positive, so we were genuinely looking forward to an evening of good food with good company. By the end of the night we were left were such a sour taste in our mouths, especially considering how much money we spent on the dinner.

Firstly, there was apparently an issue with the gas supply in Rosebank which I can understand, but you would think for such an upmarket establishment that when you are welcomed by the front of house that they would inform you of this as a patron? Especially if you have made a booking for a fairly large party and more importantly if it wipes out about 70-80% of your menu. Absolutely no grill options were available (again, something we were looking forward to). Yet no, we only found this out after we had already been seated for over an hour and already ordered drinks. The menu was also presented to us on a hand-written A4 piece of paper (only one copy might I add) which then needed to be passed around the table to decide what we would like to order from the very limited menu.

Now that we managed to place a somewhat successful order let's talk about the food itself. Firstly, the portion sizes are laughable. My wife ordered a cucumber side salad which came in what I can only describe as one of those soy sauce bowls you generally get when you order sushi and that cost R60. The cucumber salad was legitimately cucumber cut into small quarters with some form of topping on it, but seriously? R60 for that complete lack of effort? Secondly, a couple of people at the table ordered the Asian-styled ribs and that was even more of a joke. Tiny ribs, barely any meat on the bone and the season was sufficient to say the least. Someone at the table ordered the prawn pot stickers, only to find that there was barely any actual prawn meat in the dish. She had one small piece and asked that it be sent back to the Chef, only for the Chef to send the plate straight back to the table so as to essentially tell my guest that she just needs to be happy with what she received. In what world is this how you treat your patrons? You don't even have the courtesy to come to the table and perhaps hear her out? Or take some constructive criticism?

On the chef, wow - I don't even know what to say. He was incredibly disrespectful to our waitress. We saw him shouting and swearing at her when all she was doing was being the messenger between the table and himself. I think he needs a quick lesson in people skills because as the guests of the restaurant we should not have seen that. This could have been handled with a much greater sense of professionalism.

Then let's talk about the club - what a let down. Again, SO MUCH hype created around this 'secret' club where your phone's camera needs to be covered - what for, I couldn't really figure that out. The vibe was off, the music just did not gel with the space and the DJ could not read the room at all. Instead she catered for the 5 or 6 people who were actually on the dancefloor. Most of the people in the club were just standing on the sidelines or at the bar. So, for those wanting that groovey, vibey and almost 'underground' scene - this club is not for you.

All in all I think was just really disappointed in what I expected vs what I experienced. The style, theme and location of the Naked Woolf already prime it to be a sick spot before you even step through the front door but unfortunately, that was not the Naked Woolf I experienced. Let me just add that the nine other guests all share the same sentiment.

I hope the management of this establishment take this review to heart. The  majority of people don't often get to experience a place like this, so when you do and it just doesn't match up to what you expect it is so much more disappointing.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Sebastian Hardy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK3nVQNk9ZjF3t-YcUMYMSM-P4Wqa5lVLBHH75NycgIiBpoiA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Absolutely fantastic place just opened up a couple of weeks ago. You definitely need to check it out.","Images":null,"When":""}]

We celebrated our anniversary at The Pot Luck Club in Johannesburg, and what an unforgettable experience it was. From the moment we arrived, we were made to feel special — the ambiance, the attentive staff, and the impeccable attention to detail set the tone for an extraordinary evening.

We chose the tasting menu, which was a journey through bold, creative flavors and beautifully plated dishes. Each course brought something surprising and delightful — from umami-packed small plates to sweet, delicate finishes. Every dish was thoughtfully constructed, with a balance of textures and a fusion of global influences that kept us guessing (and smiling) with every bite.

The service was seamless — warm, knowledgeable, and perfectly paced. They even acknowledged our anniversary with a thoughtful touch that made the evening feel even more personal and meaningful.

The Pot Luck Club isn’t just a meal — it’s an experience. It was the perfect setting to mark our special occasion, and we’ll be talking about it for a long time. The restaurant was buzzing and full, but the service still felt warm and personal. Our waitress welcomed us with a complimentary glass of MCC for my birthday — such a thoughtful touch.

We were a group of three and ordered from the à la carte menu, sharing about four dishes each. The food is served in rounds, from light to heavy, making the experience feel like a perfectly curated tasting menu.

We kicked things off with their specialty margarita and the passionfruit cocktail — both delicious and well-balanced. Some standout dishes included the Taco 2.0, seared tuna with the most incredible sauce, beef tartare, fish sliders, and the fried calamari with a spicy, addictive sauce (we could’ve had another round of that alone!).

Other highlights were the chickpea and parmesan fries, beef fillet with café au lait sauce (absolutely divine), and the chicken wings on smoky kale — a bit too smoky for my taste, but still enjoyable.

We ended the meal with the Peanut Butter Bomb, which blew us away. It’s hands down the best peanut butter dessert I’ve ever had — rich, and bursting with flavour.

To top it all off, when the bill came, they gave us a Polaroid photo of our table printed and tucked into a little card — such a special and memorable gesture.

Every dish was a 10/10. By the way, their menu is more than just a menu, it’s full of interesting information related to Ethiopian cuisine and culture and it’s the first time I’ve actually read a menu like I’m reading an informative book.

Definitely try some coffee as well while you’re here, Ethiopians after all are known for their coffee 👍🏽👍🏽

Service was quick and very friendly. [{"Name":"NONKULULEKO YENDE","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXpZMdKYaWLTMzh2qgFBXXwcpBESg0ExdUGkmZLe1Czd9Ls-zx8tA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"We hosted a surprise 20th wedding anniversary celebration for about 30 guests at Plantation Café. While the food was beautifully prepared and well-presented, the overall experience was unfortunately let down by the service.

There was only one staff member assigned to our entire group. He served the starters, cleared plates, served the main course, cleared again, and even handled drink orders — all on his own. It was painful to watch such an obvious case of staff being overworked, and as expected, the service suffered as a result.

What made the situation worse was being charged a R650 service fee, despite the clear lack of adequate service staff. This felt unreasonable and unfair, especially considering the circumstances.

Our event was special, and while the food was good, the poor service delivery and apparent staff exploitation overshadowed the experience. I hope management takes this seriously and improves both staffing and customer service going forward.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"VictorPta","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKsVK2G8ahBZfjL7zGrUbO6fWwUsUzvolacccMiOJVT4j0OQQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba6-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"We went for the second time now to Plantation Cafe. Luckily, we already knew where it is actually located, as the place plotted on Google Maps was slightly out. It is actually immediately adjacent to the access control boom gate, and shaded parking is available to your left around the corner.
Plantation is more than a Cafe - It is a multi-dimensional venue, with several dining areas, indoor and outdoor, well suited to lost small functions. Their food catering standards are very good, although some of the portions might be small for those with a healthy appetite. But waste not - want not is my philosophy, and it won't hurt to ask for a second heping...
There are several very comfortable seating areas, some with plush couches. The decor is tastefully with soft lighting.
I loved their Butter Chicken and Basmati rice that was served at the catered function. Their Upside-Down Burger on the menu  looks yummy.
Do enquire about their restaurant / kitchen operating times, as not all items on the menu may be available at some times, especially the Indian curries. All in all a pleasant, safe venue, great ambience and centrally located.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETKnMUD_DFEYjnER4AiDMkqq_JHVpeV4rJo-An4OXdmg5g5b1-tNdCm5DZSc3lXMHrDswLfHYNag47_lG2eFgci1PfvsOtSGEJ8SVQ0VkWgJtgjloTjqrk_OF7JQdoV52WriQFOww","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEReP5PE2v5sd5JVtAICOrQDSiTU63J5DbX7j_QQNKHuw7DpEewBHN4Fqjwx4P8CrFe9buRwoGQxVMPmEVT0lZ9MwKka0uOre29OHAFMPpQTlrIus7p2Z3K3maj81UyzGz-3Xj5F","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQ_dyMKET3EqTLRfr77LU4U2O5DhkMFh-4BDeAbkmJtD_C8m4Fpv8LCGPCfEVtXpvGkatalgV-vUbfWO_pGrtdgD7h1Sj2dQMm4ha937xgF9mHiuZObgmijXcyPbY26vFcyjQld","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESEc6bnazupoNirxzL5HMMCByYEW5uZ_VD0fX3dU8KYBXfKPYQYaGvcMd-ONL3KLY6gv2U86p3lHngGdyTHXhQ6yUQ3aLqE-6l6O7YN7sLPZLL1XNGxsBujLnIU1eMd0-hZLp_F","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESQfgLMb1LExEuV0Lq7MuVZQsWZ_cOqSQiNr4d4lQi7p-ruQCzBCwToZCADGsZB3TmHMyvcodrTGdV6AQIbhDAelv1T3Vdet_sfrD2zW0Ik1GByk0ZXi14URUr0SvCdNDgDmHwDKg","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lER_PqyKL2O4fyTWad8cSZpaqG4Pifs40UCpWU7fpqwZdZGqf7TtSOZEzUdqRcn8iw8n7RqClLElAxKX8hpidfg3FRmepBHmHF5HlXHZjDoLz6gTU8rZ0FYGzJtgo7di5OeCNJjy","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERlYV3ZY6oLUjSWzmQS6KCpK47ZwuzHy9f5BcBGGz82kIK4CkpV3iYnp8L58eEx_-CLAslaijWI5XjO8Tk3HZVlvTLLjh8l6f1m0gO2Yq3xA4AcyweVYEbjPi15mLpEsujK6jaz","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERTt3G3PSbdSwMmN1j4P6makbTPFDrNezzu5a3Cl3Ei9RvJ8Qva8XrN4IH1rTOxUZyCl7GeGMgfynhfWyihI1iUibu5VtWgv6P8msfOihIZzkTcVQrS4NpLiaPL7XwI2w5QPd6x","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETHXKISfrD3TQfWZ68q0nKL98jX9jH12HqWkJ8oIldOo-7CedmOtz2o3otfnSh4VHMczY-Pz0QorS52pFTSVqZX-c1Ty_YjToggG9YFTupHok2GedaA_GEjx6xWbcPXey0WVclLjw","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERAXV6iu_MiYIBRxV9y-Ga9kXUvEIon5hXdyEy7Irxp8hIqFTl4W0UOrWPwVjmB8YjzeJ71HRCRL1KeQOdpKetZE7bAS0tyf0Pk3QZZ7fAt2yTcM4pPJtC7evUb-D7dqrAX2ixH","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQgrz8ZccqlSI6Y1K2r_gN2nZs67c-OrCEhDqpgl7K0nLKIz6fYqRN It’s a quaint venue situated in somewhat dodgy settings yet delivers quite a bang for your buck. I was there on a Saturday morning and service was exceptionally quick and efficient.

The venue wasn’t packed at all. Some patrons were there on dates, others were catching up with friends and family while others were are dressed up celebrating a friend’s birthday. Overall, the venue was quiet and peaceful.

As I left, I decided to check more of the place out. This venue is definitely way prettier inside than it is outside! I’d advise you to take your time in choosing where to sit - while outside is free and airy, inside is an absolute gem!

The bottled water here is on the small side, probably a similar concept to the way bottled water is served at Tiger’s Milk next door. If you’re really thirsty for sparkling water, you’ll be ordering tons of it just to feel satisfied. You’ll be paying for it dearly too. If you really want to drink water, you might be better off just ordering a tall glass of tap water with lots of ice and lemon.

Instead, what I received was overcooked cow heels and undercooked cow stomach, which was completely unacceptable for the price.

To make matters worse, the price for this single plate jumped from R200 to R325 without any justification in quality or quantity.

The second order was supposed to be a soup with turkey, but what arrived was green leafy vegetables with dry beef, and they even added pap that we did not order. That plate went from R65 to R160, again with no explanation.

My recent visit to Coppers Craft Bar and Grill in Bel Air was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. Located with a beautiful view overlooking Northriding/Northgate, the restaurant boasts stylish decor and a welcoming atmosphere that immediately sets the tone for a great dining experience.

We started with the Cajun prawns and chicken tacos as appetizers, and I have to say the prawns were absolutely memorable - perfectly seasoned with just the right kick of Cajun spice that had us talking about them throughout the meal. The chicken tacos were equally impressive, fresh and flavorful. I paired these with their margaritas, which were expertly crafted and refreshing.

For our main course, we opted for the sirloin with chips, accompanied by a trio of sauces - mushroom, peri peri, and pepper. The steak was cooked to perfection, tender and juicy, while the variety of sauces allowed us to customize each bite. The chips were crispy and golden, making for an excellent complement to the meal.

What truly elevated our evening was the exceptional service from our waiter, General. He was incredibly attentive throughout our visit, striking the perfect balance between being available when needed and giving us space to enjoy our meal. General was knowledgeable about the menu, enthusiastic about the restaurant's offerings, and made sure we felt well taken care of from the moment we sat down until we left.

[{"Name":"Gaya A","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJPOg53bFbuP2MfOEoPe1UX5MPuxHvDgHQg_P4dpQO5GqPhXp1U=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Ristorante La Trinita is one of those rare finds you do not expect to come across so close to places you visit all the time. Although I am often in the Kyalami Downs area, this was my first time dining at Ristorante La Trinita, and it proved to be an exceptional experience.

From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding. The staff took the time to explain the menu in detail and genuinely tried to understand what we were in the mood for. Nothing felt rushed and the experience felt personal throughout. There was also a lady whom I believe is the owner, who was incredibly warm and welcoming. She checked in on us, made conversation, and created such a comfortable atmosphere. You can truly tell when people take pride in their work and have a genuine love for food, and that really came through in the way the restaurant is run.

We ordered two pasta dishes, both made with freshly prepared pasta, and the difference was immediately noticeable. The pasta was light, beautifully cooked, and full of flavour. You could genuinely taste the freshness and care that went into each dish. What stood out most was how comfortable I felt afterwards. There was none of the heavy or bloated feeling that sometimes comes with pasta, which really speaks to the quality of the ingredients and preparation.

Overall, everything about Ristorante La Trinita felt thoughtful and authentic. From the attentive service and welcoming atmosphere to the excellent food, it is a restaurant that leaves a lasting impression. We enjoyed it so much that we already know we will be booking again.

[{"Name":"Melissa Arnold","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXaYHcZ2l1La9X8lSTViMxUZjK5pqKhWMgbyzmqjv5_qCUGvYw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"This restaurant is a textbook example of what happens when owners hustle backwards.

In South Africa, too many restaurants exploit desperation by offering “work” with no salary—only the hope of cash tips that servers rarely see, especially when tips are paid by card and deductions like “breakage fees” are quietly taken. The result is predictable: high staff turnover, zero accountability, and customer service that feels indifferent at best and hostile at worst.

Last night confirmed nothing has changed under the new ownership—if anything, it’s worse. I was the first person to walk in, greeted in isiZulu, placed a simple order (clearly stated, no pork), and was deliberately ignored while customers who arrived after me were prioritized. My order was mishandled, prices were inflated, and the entire interaction felt like a game of avoidance rather than service.

This isn’t about one bad night—it’s a management failure. When employees aren’t paid properly, they aren’t trained, valued, or motivated. When owners aren’t present, talent comes and goes unnoticed. When customers feel disrespected, they don’t return.

Pay people fairly. Train them well. Be present in your own business.
Do that, and you’ll have loyal staff, better service, fuller tables, and real profit.

[{"Name":"Dimakatso Lebusha","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWeO2Njy2gqcxcUQYgosF-J6lvshPTn6Bqqpu-F6yWFUBQJge-C=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Piatto in Carlswald is honestly such a great spot! I really enjoyed my visit — it’s aesthetically pleasing, clean, and has that “let’s chill and eat properly” vibe. Not the most beautiful restaurant ever, which is why I’m giving it a solid 4/5, but it definitely delivers where it matters.

[{"Name":"HZF FRD","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX9TsW9A-5Zm_j7D03gZwjR2RswV0JgM70kHz8wms3N5S9dUiLp=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Pizza News is where the headlines are all about deliciousness. This Muslim-owned, fully halal pizzeria serves up slices so good, you’ll be cancelling your usual pizza subscription (yes, that’s a thing now).

The moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a space that's as spotless as it is welcoming. The staff are incredibly friendly—so much so that you might wonder if you’ve wandered into a distant cousin’s home. They’re warm, attentive, and always ready to dish out recommendations, but don't be surprised if you leave with a new favorite pizza (or two).

As for the pizza itself? Imagine a crust that’s both crisp and airy, a sauce that tastes like it’s been slow-cooked for hours (because it probably has), and toppings so fresh they could headline their own farmers' market. The high-quality ingredients used here set Pizza News apart, and every bite feels like front-page news for your taste buds.

Despite the gourmet experience, the prices are surprisingly competitive, proving that you don’t have to fork out a fortune for quality. Whether you’re looking for a classic Margherita or an over-the-top meat extravaganza, there’s something here for every palate—and every budget.

So if you’re in Mayfair and craving pizza that’s big on flavor, value, and halal integrity, make your way to Pizza News. Just be prepared: once you get a taste, it’s going to be the breaking news of your week. 🍕","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQ_gh4Bkr1XhioXSmpLvn_J45XIPfrBO8xOHRURFDzBHfFFGMpWGkXbajNFDSi9x0Gx6GUY1jFGrxWr_BhJhwhCNu_l_iJkf8tidSxsB2F-qf1NUSwxXvdQ_tqVrAqsuRaX7rS_","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETYpkSjhc9hjPrD90XJGYPdrclSuxsY6F1rGEK1SV6No2rqZADXgzZJLpoFQa79pfr_BDg-3T5A-130pbDdsg76PtSRInIvv3cfnbz7KmY_9lerdxvRfLXuYMFwhpuHhTMc84YtsSxENZg","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETbqH5eHm1JzTswjF41od4ae9FzY36prw392yUic0tf1wh7ZgMrYMtUHhDIm3OTQzbkDLRkKoxUboTTSpcJiYwUxHhIxGdzmloct28ndvldwmXHCYbNiU-irwlDZWOk65Zf_MksZB13NQk","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQzGwgjgULxnPeWomCh4ER62kvFdiQWkp_7LEibIWwSZSozHwHpyRcaTY4aujPpu-AkPaIiPBR6z_cffUGeBqQffiGtDZIeorC78rqHz_Nh9zs89sIEceEQFGP83Hnyb_TDZusihN-wUmiE","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQBrppw28DNMuZmI-I3_9MpUiVsUCqEJOMq03oZGVxTjXF9vglCEB84gqEW_tg2EGOXBKrvmMhwFNgawLi3sbtVNC-kGt4954e8xJtiV2CIMK4OyBym8vZVbawwbuzcGRPIo0N8SBG6U_TT"],"When":"2024-11-1"},{"Name":"Mumtaz Moosa","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVaO8QTF-p0cXN6fd_J9-nY16FqniRWAMa1b9zKiFp-nNwQSpPF=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Let me tell you about this gem.

[{"Name":"Suhail","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVpprQi-jGZ3p2bKtotEdacWAg_GxTsYZP4V1xv55MpItbxPD8=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":""THE HOME OF LEGENDS"
Kentucky Milk Bar has always been our go to spot for the past 30 odd years for the best Toasted Steak Sandwich in JHB. The menu boasts a wide variety of burgers, toasted sandwiches and specials. The starters were incredibly generous, and the main course? It arrived in a dish fit for royalty! I thoroughly enjoyed every bite, leaving absolutely nothing behind.

Beyond the delicious food, which is always the main event, the ambiance was delightful. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with everyone around clearly enjoying themselves.

Having experienced the frustration of lost reservations elsewhere, I found their system reassuring. The confirmation email also had convenient features like cancellation and time changes, which was a nice touch.

We were a large group of over 20 people, and the waiting staff handled everything flawlessly. There wasn't a single mistake with our orders!

Great ambience and good service. Coffee is complimentary and R5 for the juice, not that one cannot afford to pay R5 when I booking at such upmarket salon but i did not get the logic of R5 for the juice when coffee is complimentary? overall pleasant experience.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Spokenpriestess","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUX5kwHv06aGt_D13EGd4w3WD6ZJeIOCzIGkwabfEmT1tSTya7F=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"I loved it.

First of all the spa is situated in a high-end building, Empire Towers in Sandton. Secondly, they're just pleasant to deal with. When I called to book the first time, I had to move my appointment twice and they were so understanding, zero qualms whatsoever, and that put me at ease.

On the day I was finally making my way, u was running late and they were still very accommodating and pleasant to deal with by moving my appointment to later.

Arriving at the spa, it was naturally quiet and rather quaint (I'm not complaining really). They have a lovely view of Sandton CBD out back which you can enjoy on a recliner if you have the time. They also offered me a delectable glass of champagne which I loved! Their water tasted like tap water so I'm not so crazy about that, but as long as Sandton water is safe to drink I'm not complaining.

The treatment room I was in was the best looking spa room I've ever seen. You know how it is at spas, the rooms are not entirely aesthetically pleasing, they're built for function. This spa however installed some light neon lighting in the walls, as well as a calming screen that plays soothing visuals like jellyfish in water. Hehe, you think some of these things are trivial but when you take note of them it actually increases your happy hormones.

Down to the treatment:
Hmm! It's been a while since I've been to the spa so my body was definitely not comfortable, especially with the built up tension in my shoulders so I enjoyed the massage. However, there were moments where I couldn't decide if the pressure was getting harder or I was just going through a lot 🤣 Either way, I can't fault the lovely masseuse tbh. I did have some soreness a day after my massage though, but that went away the following day so all is well.

Would I recommend this place? Yeah, I'd love to bring some friends here in future. They were just so pleasant man. There's something enticing about great service that makes want to be loyal to a place. Great work from the team.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETYlqvwoAgyZi0GzrbuLgwaiwxQxWELCK2RyTERP80PUmgPloafzN_sKNnFsaus3MqL23IDtXC0oMXPGmeCnqjjZEErRhxjP4mnPTL-6XcKx6SLBlXPQwmJcCqI3ddmpjWg-CHEaw","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEStmMf8iJer8N1BWsc5lYY-4F8NbhVRZJjgspE860aRFCvv-DXi6CUQJjO5XGvOrB9K50JSZos_UG0p3nIFtsT27wFPEp_GtaiN-_a72JeVJTp2SOuacJk6SYxAPXJ1FPhWcw","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERtdI5L89ngvJu8iVtEZBeVDeIXJ8FO3VSO9ZPTr_VWFKoA4v6cligS_f8FNyAl1cCH7QQBxN1Vz1is0TTLqK_5nfge_tlqN8ErctAA0fzcr49NdjKW9j4EWsIYxKzfJGBPssXb","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETKDM9nEBOMoTUOMJDbB7KgqxiDqN4pCPc6fr_ad1rduwk9uNgbBTe01qphrGLjrt_9C4h_R7tTFjEy6wJLqTZteN_AX1JXAW3xA0q6V-pPHEV5tPbOANMsj551lLZFy-p3ictr","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQRnSI3-6K7JTzBDfqoWx201NviLYPY9xl1uPnmTYBgok7PSlmPxXi5WB3f8h53mwAVg1PHW8JQaBNd1_hWsBInx7-4eB4aOEIftjdQcCzajcsIuUUHLbxWS6RT5SJ4dTcJywYg","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERwAWVKze3x48CzdwY20O-cxjOGDTxsCVulBB8Zt5Iw7CNDtknMfhrtyR4ov4OFGOy5WSIFbejqxINsdrKqtTKXYmdDNTIHZPHO-n5GLJ5DGbvpfW_bpJlOefMyAug5fsOmR7_d"],"When":"2023-1-27"},{"Name":"Philiswa Sikhilongo","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX3IP0k91RAtyxEwtxt0gnwsSWYqARBoB3fQJShWbnE4XpxJKzF=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Absolutely loved it!!! The venue is absolutely beautiful, with calming music, elegant aesthetics, and well-maintained facilities that create a truly serene and relaxing atmosphere.
The staff as a whole were warm, professional, and genuinely kind, which made the experience even more enjoyable. A special mention goes to Bridget, who provided outstanding service. She was attentive, highly skilled, and very knowledgeable, taking the time to explain treatments and products clearly and thoughtfully.
Bridget represented the Renaissance Spa brand with excellence. Her recommendations were confident and well-informed, and she introduced products and a potential membership in a way that felt natural and pressure-free.
Overall, Renaissance Spa offers exceptional value for money. The quality of service, the beautiful environment, and the level of care provided far exceeded expectations. Wouldn’t go again just for that reason.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Alyssa Joan Smith","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWHeWc1N-borNf-ZV-TKebJN778atTRzXt_6vSW3whD0wpZH-Jn=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"In short: An incredible experience at the Renaissance Day Spa in Sandton. If you’re contemplating based on the other reviews, as I was - just try it - you can thank me later! This spa is the epitome of a hidden gem.

Expanded: Spent the day at the spa, after having a deep tissue full body massage, which has been one of the best massages I have had to date (and I have had many), thanks to Thandi, the therapist who provided the service. Careful, meticulous, and a complete stress relief.

After our massage session we spent time in the Rasual chamber. An unforgettable sensory experience.

There are so many elements to appreciate that made this spa day exquisite both big and small (the Roman Bath, rooftop pool, six jet shower) that I would encourage you try for yourself.

Yet the golden thread, throughout, was the hospitality of the staff, Bernadine, in particular. From the moment of calling in until leaving the spa, she went out of her way to ensure we were well taken care of. Bernadine, your kindness set the tone of warmth for the experience we had. Thank you.

[{"Name":"Nadia Esther","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJNaabJz8IX18TOWqrB_0R4Dxs4gmy6AYr_MYqaWTxwPAtk-A=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Im so glad I found this hair salon. My hair came out very beautifully and I received lots of compliments.So grateful","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Nqobile Hlophe","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUvfEQ0gPy_H2F1lZ7uxlNcOd7oHVaDUUN21ETFymsogNX77BaZwQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"Today, I had my first—and likely last—appointment at Noir Hair and Beauty. I booked a hair relaxing treatment for R350 and noticed that "blow-dry" was listed as a recommendation on the booking app. Based on this, I assumed it was an optional styling service rather than a necessary part of completing the treatment process.

However, upon arrival, I was told that drying my hair was not included and that I would need to pay an additional R220 if I wanted my hair dried. This caught me off guard, as, in my experience, no salon sends clients home with wet hair after a chemical treatment unless they specifically choose a style. I felt misled—not because of the cost, but because I wasn't given clear information upfront.

Had the booking system explicitly stated that ‘blow dry’ was required and came with an extra charge, I would have had no issue with it. My frustration stems from the lack of transparency, which left me with no choice. I prefer to know the full cost of a service upfront, not after I’ve committed my time and canceled other plans.

To be clear, this is not about the money. In fact, two weeks later, I was prepared to spend more than the relaxer itself (which ended up being R570) on a post-relaxer treatment (which was going to be R670) that Petronella, the stylist, recommended for healthier hair. Speaking of which, Petronella was wonderful and the only reason I’m giving two stars instead of one.

I hope the salon improves its pricing clarity to avoid unnecessary frustration for future clients.

Edit: After my experience, I attempted to rebook for the post-relaxer treatment, only to find that I was blocked from making an appointment. Wanting to clear up any misunderstanding, I reached out to the owner privately to explain my concerns. I clarified that I only tried to rebook because Petronella, the stylist, recommended a post-relaxer treatment that would benefit the health of my hair. I also made it clear that my issue was never about the price itself—her prices are her business—but rather the pricing structure. Drying hair is a necessary part of a relaxer treatment, not an optional add-on, and I was surprised to find it being charged separately without clear communication upfront.

Unfortunately, instead of acknowledging this as a valid concern about transparency and customer service, the owner reframed the issue as me refusing to pay her set fees—which was never the case. She even made comparisons to high-end grocery stores like Woolworths and Pick n Pay, suggesting that I simply couldn’t afford her services. This was both inaccurate and dismissive. If I had an issue with her prices, why would I have tried to book again?

Her refusal to acknowledge my actual concern, combined with blocking me instead of addressing it professionally, only reinforced my frustration. It’s a shame because I was genuinely willing to give them another chance, especially based on Petronella’s recommendation. However, it’s clear that customer feedback and service are not priorities for the owner.

I’m sharing this review to clarify why I attempted to book again and what my real issue was. This was never about trying to dictate how a business should operate—it was about expecting transparency and proper communication, qualities that any reputable business should prioritize to ensure a positive customer experience","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"SD","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXY5II_iQo0asX2oKUvB2E2n1zyDOq8FXpU9hDlO20KFTZpUkslrA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Came for a relaxer root touch up. [{"Name":"Manoo Goldie","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKhGG28veenrV7E5XdDMmlQ_tAlwv3dA3ewWiecpQAh5m3nkw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"A month ago, I made an appointment with Chantal to cut my hair because she seemed to have good reviews. The moment I sat down with her, I sensed impatience. I showed her some photographs of what I wanted done. She took a quick look and proceeded to cut my hair. She began by cutting the sides extremely short. Alarmed, I immediately asked her what she was doing and told her that it was way shorter than the photograph depicted. I had to take her through the photographs again. This time, I had to talk her though the photograph.  She realised that she had made a terrible error by cutting my sides extremely short. Then she tried to do damage control. To do this, she took the top of my hair and brought it down the sides to cover her mistakes up. So, my haircut went very badly indeed. I made the appointment with her because she had good reviews. Chantal might be good with doing the basics such as blow drying hair. However, if you are looking for someone who is technically skilled, Chantal is not your person. She does not have the requisite skillset to do a technically complex short haircut.  Chantal isn't just an unskilled hair stylist, she was also very impatient, rude, disrespectful and unfriendly towards me. She did not smile at me, or speak to me in a friendly, approachable manner even once during the entire appointment. After the terrible experience with Chantal, I came home and gave her a one star rating, If I could give her zero stars or negative stars, I would have done so.  But I then deleted the rating because I did not want to rate her poorly, if I did not give the haircut time. My hair is very curly and, therefore, very forgiving. It's quite easy for me to fix a mistake because my hair is so curly. So, I decided to give this huge mistake of a haircut a chance to see if I could still style it and make it work for me. However, I just cannot. I am struggling with it now for more than a month.  The hair that was used to cover the mistake (of the sides that were cut tooo short) is now hanging flat from the top, with blunt edges that don't even curl. They just stick out at the two sides, and there's nothing much that I can do except to wait for it to grow out before I will have long enough hair at the sides, to have it reshaped.  So, it is a long process of struggling with this very bad haircut for a few more months. I feel that I gave it a long enough time to see if I could make it work. Since I am still struggling with it so much, I now feel that the bad review is more than justified.  I will never again go back to Chantal for anything; and I certainly do not recommend her to anyone either.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Nicole Johansen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJd2igd9MFs5knUbM9TigqgimD4P5rTVeyrkgAsj7UShp-k3w=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I have had on multiple occasions the most amazing experience from the time you sit down to getting your hair washed and massaged you are instantly taken into a zone of tranquility and coming out fabulous as ever!! From the wash to the blow-dry, the service was poor. [{"Name":"Megan Kleyn","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU1VAvCnXrQqcb4B81oejG61NCG3VP12CsTGhBRyEPHumsKcTuSiA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Just wow! Megan is amazing. I am 41, and until Megan I had never really found a hairdresser that I liked or trusted. Before you write me off as a "fussy customer", let me explain that I am a simple person. What I want from a hairdresser is as follows: (1) Someone who really understands curly hair and can cut it properly, so that it maintains it's natural curl (I don't have the time or eneregy to use a GHD everyday). (2) Someone who is reasonably priced. (3) Someone with a clean salon (4) Someone who is conveniently located. (5) Someone who doesn't try and coerce me into buying expensive products I can't afford. Although (I suspect) it's  relatively easy for someone with straight hair to find a hairdresser who fulfills these criteria, I have had difficulty my whole life. Megan however, is different, and scores 5 out of 5 on my "hairdresser test". (1) She is a stellar curly cutter, and has given me a style that is quick and easy to style (I'm a wash and go girl) and maintains my natural curl. (2) She is very keanly price (3) Her salon is immaculate (4) This depends on where you live, but for those who live in Roodepoort, the salon is centrally located on Ontdekkers Road. (5) Megan has only ever recommended and sold me products on request. She respects my budget (and I box dye my hair - In the past, this has led to me paying over 1k for colouring I knew I could not afford, and then never returning to the salon. Maybe I am too sensitive, but in the past I have experienced professionals in the hair and beauty industry making me feel very insecure in order to encourage me to buy products (the "your hair/skin is SO dry, it really doesn't look good, buy this expensive product and it will look great"). I have literally burst into tears after treatments / haircuts at salons. What I love about Megan is that she focuses on her clients' assets and respects their budgets. I leave her salon feeling better about myself: Like a strong, beautiful, empowered woman, like a curly queen. I'lll upload some before and after photos later if I have time. Thank you, Megan!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Yo'z Naturali","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWnKTvCcSEakymwWCHKf1Zy2L4cm729ar6FDHduJZg97NSwUpOY=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"You can call me a happy and content straight natural woman with big dreams and aspirations for my hair.

So I had my first visit with Soy Amado Natural Curly Hairstylist. Although it was my first visit it was my second engagement with Megan.

My first engagement was a consultation which happened via WhatsApp that was scheduled via the booking app. Megan was very patient with me and she listened to me and answered all my questions and addressed all my concerns. Megan respected me as a straight natural woman who has had many highs and lows when coming to the hair care journey. After my consultation I immediately booked an appointment for a treatment and silk press.

Yesterday I went in for my first visit, my hair was a mess as my last coffee botox treatment was in January, the new growth was tangled and my hair was also falling. When I was there Megan was interested in the overall journey, health and care of my hair and scalp! She educated me and opened my eyes on some of the things I didn't know.

Because of the condition of my hair and the fact that I am on skin medication, Megan advised against the Brazilian because it was harsh and to go for the Japanese treatment instead as it was gentler.

From the moment she washed my hair until she was done Megan was very gentle! During wash she didn't pull and tug at my hair. The blow dryer and flat iron NEVER BURNT ME!!! After the blow dryer she had won me over as a customer. I have been doing silk presses going for 2 yrs now and I could no longer handle the hot and burning hairdryers and the burns from the flat iron. If there is one thing about me is that I do speak up, so in my previous life I would complain to tye hairstylist about the heat and I would be told it's part of the process, "this is how it should be". And I would be left with a tender and painful scalp in which the pain would take plus minus one month to settle!

This time around, I did my first ever pain-free silk press and today, not even 24 hrs later there is no soreness no tenderness no pain of any sort. I can touch my hair, head and scalp without wincing.

I have 4c hair and my silk press is amazing! My hair is silky and light and fluffy and just plain amazing. And again without the pain!

I shared with Megan my hair goals and aspirations and my likes and dislikes as well as my fears and concerns. And from her well informed and caring responses and guidance I am confident that I have found a home for my hair and I so so look forward to my next appointment and to seeing what the future holds.

My recommendation is visit her once and draw your own conclusions, don't just take my word for it 😇😜

Once again... thank you Soy Amado Natural Curly Hairstylist... thank you Megan! May you show the same understanding, care, love, respect and gentleness as you have shown to me, to all your other customers. And yes... my sister will also be coming soon for her own silk press 😅","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Vutivi Vukeya","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK9o3stP-jE0XTaR1dILjaLMWuzVfpeV_4j8SizVjNoKsBgYw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Rude and not serious about their business. You will wait at the door while they sit and look at their phones.

I came to your shop with my son and there was a lady on the couch on her phone while another one was doing someone's hair. I stood at the door until the one doing the hair stopped and came to the door and she was already irritant and impatient. She confirmed that this was Amado then rudely told me they don't do boys hair - yet your profile has an image of a young boy washing hair? As for your threats you are only exposing what you are. I was 100% ripped off and I will be sharing this terrible experience with family and friends.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Yolinde Morgan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU9oaREP2_jEWjE4BzrTTt6HmMqQc8NRkDrPgDlQcswfsoinjA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I’m really loving my hair. I seldom have a good outcome from a stylist for that reason I hardly go to the salon. My daughter told me about glow and I really needed a pick-me-up after being sick. I was anxious while I was there but pleasantly surprised by the outcome. Ricardo knows his stuff and I will be back.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Shanine Alistoun","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWn5aMzLTwcx1PcvwhoVvWdFUd46s4-LK_b_RxPvUnP5GvibIJ0=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I went in for a curly bob haircut in June 2024, clearly explaining what I wanted and even showing the stylist inspiration pictures. The stylist assured me they could do a proper curly cut, so I trusted the process.

As she worked, I kept checking in, expressing my concerns that the cut didn’t seem right. She reassured me, but by the time I could truly see what was happening, it was too late—my hair had been completely butchered. Instead of the natural curly bob I asked for, I was left with an uneven, unintentional afro.

I immediately raised the issue with the owner, Kelly, and also left a negative review. Kelly was very apologetic, admitted fault, and acknowledged that they did not specialize in curly hair. To make amends, she offered to send me to a curly hair specialist she personally knew for a corrective cut. However, since my hair was already too short to fix at that point, I suggested waiting until it grew out later in the year or early 2025. Kelly agreed and assured me she would arrange the appointment when I was ready. The only thing she asked in return was for me to remove my negative review, as it was affecting her business, which I did because she seemed sincere in offering a solution.

Fast forward to February 2025—now that my hair had grown enough to be shaped, I reached out to Kelly as agreed. To my disappointment, she completely went back on her word, now claiming that while they could shape my hair, they still didn’t have a curly hair specialist. This response showed a complete lack of integrity and respect for clients who trust them with such an important part of their self-image.

This review isn’t out of spite but rather to warn others about what they might be getting into—a salon that takes no real responsibility for their mistakes and handles customer concerns carelessly.

This is just a brief summary of what transpired. My original, more detailed review was removed because Kelly requested it when she promised to make things right. Unfortunately, that promise turned out to be empty.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Ash Leigh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJXJ8h04VMGdaPMCZoZxwBtQCk4saa3Vc5rPJArmnGzpO0L4g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I’m extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Glow. I booked a Botox treatment for my sister, but when it was time to pay, I was blindsided with an additional charge of R450 for an extra 30ml of product. This was never discussed beforehand, which feels dishonest.

I decided to pay the exorbitant fee, thinking it would result in healthier, more manageable hair for my sister.However, after washing her hair, it looked like it had been relaxed — not just a looser curl pattern but heat-damaged, overprocessed and completely straight. I’ve had Botox treatments before, and this is not what I expected or paid for.

As a former regular customer, I’m deeply disappointed. This experience has made me lose trust in Glow, and I won’t be returning. 1 star.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Jezebel Smit","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVBhROSEReqDf6YtZc2tVPqKQrbaK_Zft7WrPVT-fnG12jBiOMA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Iv done my hair at the salon a few times and i have no complaints about the hair.

However i did my eye lashes at the salon yesterday and what a nightmare. Long story short i asked them to remove the lashes. Which was next to impossible because it was stuck on and sealed like cement. I am getting married in a few days and now my eye lashes are ruined.
I was sent home with half the lashes still on and when i contacted the salon the next day explaining that i was in a lot of pain and that the lashes were still not off and all i received was an apology. No further assistance- nothing!

I agree that the salon is unprofessional and really needs proper management. It is a business after all. The behavior in the salon is nit professional. I am sitting with red eyes. Half of my eye lashes ripped out and then a few rock hard glued eye lashes in my eyes. I have a special occasion today and now i have to go like this.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Fatimah Edwards","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUHOyt5ooEBDi_L1BvnOP_YC9FawLuvOXV5XZW5mpha3tqFyAsZ0g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I would give 0 stars if I could. Very unprofessional, miserable staff and unfriendly. I'm extremely dissatisfied with my hair and the customer service received. The disrespect and unprofessionalism I received from the hairstylist I dealt with was shocking. I've never been to a salon where I was treated this way for a service I paid for. I would not recommend this place to anyone doing color or treatment. The color came out terribly wrong and I was blamed for it but no instruction was followed , I had to come the next day to fix it and the audacity for the stylist to lose her temper with me I was so ready to walk out. The botox treatment is overpriced and made my mom's hair and my hair turn extremely yellow. Bare in mind I've got blonde hair and my mom has WHITE hair, I simply wanted to lighten my money piece but it seemed as if this was a mission and treated as if I didn't know what I wanted or was a burden. Very very unprofessional I will never ever go back here. I can't say all the hair stylists are like this but I can only imagine if one is like that. The customer service and quality of work is TERRIBLE.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Char Nell","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU4qW1JVQDhDtleoUGwdbOBhAdGXCJN5FKzIyYT9nLglfkZcP8=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Never have I felt so welcome in a hair salon before!! [{"Name":"David Coughlan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUdS6PsvAtlIp9sCATh26moBJUll0dNvY5HAlbftJmTcEES2TkX=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"There is no aircon and it is as a hot day…

The barber charged me R330 for quick back and sides with machine cut.

The equipment is all old and the guys scissors were blunt. He kept pulling my hair and my neck was burning afterwards.

I got home so annoyed and the haircut was terrible.

What a waste of my money, time and suffering.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"XolanS (King)","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVWgIkWOP5bXZiPIMUsh9uVomt2iHVNQ3hTYV7TskZM1bjZK-FTgA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Bad service! 🤦🏽‍♂️ Three barbers just sitting around chatting while I’m told to “wait for someone available.” Not one bothered to cut my hair. Waste of time and full of bad attitude.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Austin Mpofu","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUgKKUXKnwzVri2ZMfslFj_FM2QDGt4K0CwMAsxZoENOUNK1QOU=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"First time here and Jay absolutely did a fantastic cut such a nccaaa job","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ANxoTn0U_AmVNQKAZ_LcbUyl1ytU5SyVu9V11YiTxaNT6scrG_16jetNPU6PqnMAkP_ZlC9SptPkz1BVVzy2NU967_WDLQvE1cgsVqcFdA3FLylLf1Og7lmYnRiAYSO_7LMI4PpPmsRK=k-no"],"When":"2025-5-31"},{"Name":"Avril Plaatjies","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVFXQHC8hUjjPI3KNtp0_mcADOWS7KxvZn-Aec2wLQri_qzyF_gQQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I love the service and treatment at Legends Barber Rosebank. The staff is professional and friendly.
My boys have had the best experience with every visit.

My baby boy loves sitting on the makeshift booster seats it's comfortable and he is always happy 😁

Lee always kills it 😎🫡

Very happy customer and client for the past 2 years and going strong.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lesetja Marome","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJw13lLXNAUxmY7ayk4Gtr3rDJ7Xt6Ih4B0KQMzXtx-Q8z3wA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Really disappointed with my experience at Legends Rosebank. When I wasn’t happy and asked him to fix my haircut (which is fair considering the R200 price), he got upset instead of handling it professionally. He also doesn’t do proper check-ins during the cut to make sure he’s on the right track.

Not worth the money. I won’t be coming back.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Brandon Ferlito","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJpuNO-VNAGSWXuyPNrJTdCmTAvk4fYc3VbtMyQtixbg-N5qlS1=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"This barbershop has a great atmosphere with nice music that adds to the experience. Nathaniel (Nates), my barber, is truly talented and gifted. He consistently gives me excellent cuts that leave me feeling confident every time. His attention to detail and skill make every visit worthwhile. I highly recommend him!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Andile Nqumba","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKOGd_VyhBKJR_8kECwM_GJTJNIKk_J34kP6E8CXPJeqqZykw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Bentley was excellent - he was professional in doing my fade. Ask about the trial week and drop in for a couple of classes - easy peasy.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Dominique Wells","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJNS_NHExkd5i2Y6EYCM2jij2TA_SnIfNZeGG15Rq5gHo2rOA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Have been going here for about 2 months now. If you're new to CrossFit (like myself) and looking for a place where you'll feel welcome and not intimidated, I'd highly recommend.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Tambu Ndoro","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWD5u4jcO1h5xO8DrrVQgyR-_xEW6crkO6j1Vm-EYPtCuAJmN8x=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I love this gym. Cyprium will always be my 2nd home when I am in the area!  Professional coaches and excellent facilities and lovely diverse community.  Highly recommended.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Raine O'Neill","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV5hwA88B77Cva8QeKiyEzfBRMcUg-pZ9fDW-Qr0WuIWTcWHORs=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Love this gym! It was my first time joining a CrossFit gym so I felt nervous to start, but the instructors and the people made me feel so welcome and completely at ease that my nerves were quickly forgotten. The facilities are clean and the gym is well equipped with plenty of weights, powerlifting racks, an outdoor sprint track, rowing machines, and spin bikes to name a few. You have access to trainers who are highly knowledgeable, always willing to help push and motivate you to achieve your goals and also make the workouts enjoyable. I highly recommend CrossFit Cyprium not only as a way to train, build up cardio and strength, but to also be apart of a fantastic team!","Images":null,"When":""}]

The team here is hardworking, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They’ve created a place that feels like a true family barbershop, where everyone’s welcome and the vibe is always good.

[{"Name":"Caitlin Joy Muhle-Hees","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVwZXh3Jwj4Yyeit1w0JQ5B-2N42h5K7WgmMdjjsWBBjFXmUDwR_w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Forgot to take photos of the front of house and treadmill/ cardio area. So will do that next time I go.

Overall the equipment could use an upgrade, some of the weight lifting machines are either very outdated or missing some parts.

The functional area is really nice and clean. The classes area is really nice except during loadshedding as the lights aren't connected to the generator. So it becomes super dark.

The area isn't exactly the best, with the free parking, and in the same area as the China mall, it doesn't feel as luxurious as other Viva gyms. However there are plenty of security on site that do stay until late into the evening.

However what changes this gym to a four star for me, is the staff, they truly go above and beyond for the area, the clients and dedication to fitness. They are always willing to help and so friendly.

The music in the gym can be weird but normally very nice to exercise to. There are screens and projectors around showing off all the latest sport events.

Another plus is the water pressure in the showers and how clean the bathrooms are.

They also have many different options for exercise classes and group fitness which is really nice to join.

It is much bigger than the other branches of Viva with more space to work out.

Overall a really nice place to exercise, just could use some upgrades to some equipment.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQlbwc2cKNDGrRKtcLS70dBQB3AUw8Z7UVlxPI5Nldmw34efeQ_CrCYDef8HeABlYbrb0tnswnVeeC0WGoxKZcqyEjP-qzkjsBB3GrSpK5rrz0zS5o8Gbh3WKWwxzrI5oMQSUhetQ","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQQ98xekGG9Nwyu56j0cnxOgXJr0PxgobF4_v3qioqJt1cIy8wDl5yz1Je9y-CYl2nMYHp6xL88uxfSj7WOaAEi4p9IcJN5vFs_PEVpD91S2RBp_naei8lrg41jrzwgliCqAPo","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQ0WBtdog9d-0mWUFDp2bk3lrHQPws247sKdap0lD0VOxdvaBTCQSoERSCdxMKNNFSN0VHfSfNrx94KIkvIxdiPl9VZ_VMRPv-tJ0IqaUhu3AyGNkk5rhsn8DhvoCojH3kqzjDY","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETWl2qtEdRYsKVqYKhXE3hgkzXIZc9N7d45PwrY2OR6GzLjPTCe4b0hr6vBEA_58Smki7BZeO3Pc65-J8HsyVwukUGo2Wg8sBD1KQ7lXOPerQCC9A_swSAqO1Y4oCamtQ1UPrVK","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lES__H1nWP_NdE2U5BtkwfW6NP9G0pSRmrPStDKCM4_Fv6ysA72KvrwYkyb1MnOp88ui8i1ztoBOz8VYxpHm4E7kHipq0D-OIH3ODY-rnPxX9FqTEBc1fZ0RNRtXU35-4u5L-DZPaA"],"When":"2023-11-14"},{"Name":"Natascha Fesenmeier","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUvNmAjIkWLP6otlcHc-XhYBjG8Zt-rJl03fa1_lYNRjEU8lqx1=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":3,"Description":"Honestly i love this gym. The gym is well equipped with all the necessary gym equipment, to assist with your goals whatever they may be, losing weight, getting fit, building muscle etc.
There are so many value added extras, this post would turn into a long essay. :)

However, it's essential to exercise caution regarding personal belongings, as there have been reports of theft within the premises. My experience serves as a case in point: shortly after joining a week ago, We encountered a loss. A mobile phone, securely placed within a gym bag near the shower area, went missing during my visit. At the time, the only individuals present in the locker room were two black women, one notably sporting short, blond hair. Unfortunately, both the phone and the individuals were absent upon returning from the shower.

Upon addressing the issue with the gym's customer support, it was disheartening to learn that such incidents are not uncommon here. Conversations with fellow gym-goers further revealed a pattern of thefts, including a specific instance involving a member who exploited the gym facilities to commit theft.

Given the frequency of these incidents and the apparent knowledge of the culprits' identities without adequate resolution, I advise potential members to consider these factors seriously before joining. The safety of personal items appears to be a significant concern at this location.

Best regards,
Jean","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"chris mudau","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIqSjqkid4C5xeeIDPCPL9SMZ3ELJB46xLX8_f0w8sluXkROg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"The gym has always been a sanctuary for many of us, a place to destress and focus on our well-being. However, recent upgrades seem to have changed the atmosphere. Rather than feeling empowered, we're now constantly micromanaged on how to handle the equipment, as if we're incapable adults. Perhaps the intention was good, but it's resulted in frustration and a sense of being patronized. It would have been better if the upgrades had focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment for everyone. Unfortunately, the treatment from the gym owner and staff has become intolerable, leading me to make the difficult decision to cancel my membership.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Elemore Van Der Merwe","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUZwX2_TeH83GbRXBrIs5D39OaLJ6He72ewLmUapApFpRbZC3h5=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Please read this before committing to the month to month package blindly.

When you hear month to month it sounds nice as you can go to the gym at months that you have budgeted for.

Other months when you are a little short on money you can skip. Life is very unexpected therefore this package sounded great.

a family friend an I signed up at Viva to start our journey, we chose the month to month option and had to give our banking details even though we requested to pay each month we were going to gym.

This already should have been a red flag, but as young adults that have never been in a situation where we have been deceived before and lost money we didn’t think anything of it.

I will admit that we did not read the terms and conditions as we were promised to receive a confirmation of membership on email with the needed information. On this email it clearly states the following: If you chose MONTH TO MONTH MEMBERSHIP, then this is the flexible monthly membership which does not have a fixed commitment.

We made use of their facilities for a month, we agreed that the upcoming month thereafter we won’t be able to go to the gym as we both had to take our cars in for a service.

We would have returned to the gym if it wasn’t for what happened next. a debit order went off from both our accounts.

I phoned in and was assisted by a lady, I explained to her that I really can not afford to have that money deducted that month and that it doesn’t make any sense as I agreed to the month to month option.

She was so cold and careless towards me and said that I should have cancelled online and PAID a cancellation fee and she warned me that if I were to reverse the payment they will deduct double the amount the next month. What?! This wasn’t discussed with us at all when we registered at the gym.

The least they could have done was email us the contracts that we have signed after registering so that we could have read through the terms and conditions without feeling rushed. At least we would have been aware of the situation before it escalated.

They continue to deduct money from my friend’s account. Money she really needs to get through the month. As for me, I made sure not to have money in the bank account details I gave them.

Please do not fall for this. I have read some reviews where it happened to other people as well. These people do not care about you or anyone. They only see money and not the person.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Travis Davids","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV5e9bfNcwT4aaEKox_UmbkHYIMQOjXkEU6uqCnCP73Rxebuox32Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba7-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I've been going here for a couple years. I have zero complaints. Best gym ever. They are following strict covid protocols. Temperature checks and hand sanitizing upon entry. There are also sanitizing sprays and cloths to wipe down equipment and machines before and after use. I love this gym. Not too big and not too small. It's also affordable. I try not to go in the evenings as it get's too full and finding weights and equipment can be a bit of a hassle but during the early afternoon (around 1pm) It's complete freedom. Machines are well maintained.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Amanda Raath","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWXHqiwKH0TVV4kCW4cGjiYMnYeSTy-hcnSXNHNuKzDL3zcLazJ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I love this gym because of the fact that you can be who you are here. You are surrounded by all types of people - older people, students, professionals... so you don't feel like you need to wear the latest active wear or know what you are doing.... they have videos around the gym showing exercises you could do if you have no idea what to do, and the equipment is good, it seems like they are also replacing some of the equipment with newer models which is also great.","Images":null,"When":""}]

[{"Name":"Tiaan De Beer","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKnW2VLDUGqIsRwOI30R7gCR3hXJz9wAmTXQqnj2lf65vtwdw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Amazing CrossFit Gym Experience!

I've been training at this CrossFit gym for a while now, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. The coaches are incredibly knowledgeable about the sport and bring a wealth of expertise to every session. What truly sets them apart is their personalized approach to training.

They take the time to understand each individual's fitness level and goals, ensuring that every workout is tailored to help you succeed. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, the coaches are committed to helping you get into the best shape possible.
