I love this place. Amazing facility, always clean and neat.

There's a grid area, treadmill area, boxing area, cycling room, studios for pilates, yoga and other activities, a swimming pool, sauna, steam room, a cold plunge and more.

You can use the Virgin Active app to scan and enter the facility, book/pre-book classes, claim your weekly rewards, etc

There are therapy facilities available (Biokinetics, Physio, etc)

Facility caters for every type of person, from regular active people to elites

The facility has a Kauai inside

There's ample parking outside and you won't have a problem getting park, even if it's peak times of the day.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Shalom Sigalow","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXJQBACVHRqusvqpRX5Z13GmeorGlz_izhJiLIV6heFiM9bonw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Very impressive for a standard virgin active - they have modernized the aesthetic, and definitely amped up the quality of the facility.
The work stations are very functional, elegant and seemingly promotes social well being (people seem to enjoy the space for both social, and work purposes)
The cardio section is great, but they should upgrade the treadmills.
The locker rooms are absolutely incredible.
It is very aesthetically pleasing, functional and almost on pair with a collection club (Despite the blow dryers being outdated)
The sauna, steam room and shower are well maintained.
The weight training section was upgraded as well, and is very functional and suitable for group exercises.
Overall, a very good VA in the Roodepoort area.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Phumlani Mbabela","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVXiZWWOHazbJw4dMKQuDkzZMzqomFtRGpXo9SSAh1t2Ar14LzpGg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nomthandazo, Olga, Lwazi, Thaphelo & Zenande – The Team That Defines a Safe, Welcoming, and Progressive Virgin Active Community

Virgin Active South Africa – Roodepoort (14th Avenue) is a gym that genuinely lives up to the idea of community. The facility is clean, well-managed, and creates an environment where people can train with focus and confidence.

A special commendation goes to Nomthandazo, whose hospitality, professionalism, and warmth consistently make members feel welcome. She sets a positive tone and contributes to an atmosphere that is inclusive, respectful, and forward-thinking.

I also want to recognise Olga (Shift Manager), Lwazi, Thaphelo, and Zenande for their outstanding professionalism. Last month, I experienced an incident where another member attempted to bully me. I raised the issue, and it was handled swiftly, seriously, and with care. The team addressed my complaint, ensured my safety, and even walked me to my car. That level of responsibility and empathy is rare and deeply appreciated.

Because of their response, I felt protected, respected, and truly valued as both a customer and a member of the Virgin Active community. This team demonstrated leadership, accountability, and genuine concern for member wellbeing.

I've been a member at Gym Company Westgate since 2021,but my recent visit was extremely disappointing. The gym's facilities, specifically the showers and sauna, were not functioning out of 8 showers only 4 are functional and extremely filthy. This is unacceptable for a gym that prides itself on providing a comprehensive fitness experience.

As someone who values cleanliness and relaxation after a workout, the non-functional showers and sauna were a major letdown. It's not too much to expect basic amenities to be in working order, especially considering the membership fees and annual maintenance fee that I pay diligently.

Further to that Experience with Rude Staff

The staff seemed completely disinterested in attending to members. What's worse, they were glued to their cell phones the entire time! It was frustrating to see them more focused on their personal conversations than on ensuring members had a good workout experience.

As a paying customer, I expect a certain level of professionalism and courtesy. The staff's behavior fell far short of my expectations.

I hope the management takes immediate action to address these issues. Until then, I would caution potential members to think twice before joining.

Rating: 1/5 stars it should actually be a 0","Images":null,"When":""}]

- *Sanitiser stations* are limited to the studio. With so many members moving between the gym, cardio zone and studios, extra dispensers would help keep germs at bay.

- *Bins* are scarce. The ladies’ changing room only has one small bin, and there are few waste containers around the club.

- *Shower amenities* need a few upgrades: hooks for towels, a shelf or soap tray, and a shoe compartment inside lockers would make the space much more user‑friendly.

- *Blocked shower drain* was reported yesterday. The cleaning staff noted it just needed a deeper clean, but it’s still an issue.

Genuinely. If you are considering joining, I strongly suggest that you request to record your onboarding session because they will go back on everything they said.

This has been the worst experience I’ve had with both the service providers and the management of this establishment. They are dishonest and completely incompetent at their jobs. They failed,  and I suspect on purpose, to clearly mention the actual cancellation terms to me.

I joined last year specifically because they offered a month-to-month deal. This was reiterated multiple times during onboarding by Savannah, and it was also stated in one of my contracts that I only needed to give one month’s notice to cancel. However, there were two contracts. One clearly states one month’s notice, and another says three months. What they do NOT include in the three-month clause is that the customer will be required to pay the full gym fee for those next three months. When I spoke to the manager, Douglas Russell, on the phone, he admitted that other people have complained about the dishonest wording of the contract. He even said I was the first person to actually ask for the contract. I am not surprised, it is incredibly difficult to get hold of them, and even harder to get them to follow up on anything.

When I was told I am obligated to pay the full gym fees for the next three months, I asked to be sent the contract. I had to call again seven days later to remind them to send it. When I called, Douglas Russell wasn’t in, and the person who answered said she would pass on the message. I then had to call again three hours later to ask if he was in. He was. Even my initial cancellation request required follow-ups. They are impossible to both work andt reason with.

Douglas Russell was rude and kept going in circles repeating that “it’s policy”,  a policy they failed to properly relay to me multiple times: once during physical onboarding when I signed, and again in the contract where the wording is vague and contradictory. He claimed that I was called the same day as my onboarding by Musia at 17:59, and that the terms and conditions were reiterated to me. That is not true. I have no record of such a call. Even he could not confidently confirm that those terms were actually explained. He didn’t care to prove or disprove anything. He didn’t care that there have been multiple complaints about this issue.

I even suggested that perhaps they should revise the wording of the contract to be more explicit. There is nothing inherently wrong with having a three-month policy, but be clear about it. Be transparent. Anyone who actually cared about accountability would have taken that suggestion seriously and apologised for the confusion. Instead, he kept repeating that Savannah is no longer working there, which is completely irrelevant. It wasn’t just her. The omission happened throughout the entire onboarding process.

I’m writing this because I am regretful and shocked by the lack of accountability and manipulation that I endured. If they are this difficult to deal with over something as basic as cancellation terms, I can only imagine how they operate in other areas.

Proceed with caution.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Rachel Leistra","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJnhBSQszS9_6N6_p0VBTTrudZYXuki8FGzCTRrS97lCDhN6Qg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"AVOID!!!!!
I do not recommend this gym to anyone. My experience with The Gym Company Bromhof has been extremely disappointing and I would go so far as to call their business practices unethical.

My husband (who is American) and I came from Poland to South Africa to visit my family (I am South African) for a holiday in July/August 2024. We both paid for 3-month passes but only trained for 2 months during that stay.
In 2025, we returned to South Africa for 6 weeks and purchased once-off memberships for R550 each, plus the additional tag fee (despite already having a black tag from the previous year, they insisted we had to buy another one).
At the time of purchase, one of the staff members (a lady with a shaved head and glasses) informed us that we had overpaid for our 2024 memberships and that the credit from that overpayment had been applied to our 2025 memberships. Based on this information, I proceeded with the card payments on 4 July 2025 for both myself and my husband.
At that point, we were satisfied.

However, nearly 3 months later, we began receiving harassing emails and WhatsApps claiming that we owed money, including threats about “negative credits” and bills that showed us as being in debt to the gym. This directly contradicts what their own staff had told us when we signed up.
This has left us feeling deceived and extremely frustrated. We paid what was asked, we were told we had credit, and now the gym is spamming us with demands for money we do not owe. This is MONTHS later. I still receive threat emails today and I am in Poland. If this carries on I will take legal action to stop the harassment. This is harassment.

I cannot stress enough: avoid this gym at all costs. Their administration is unprofessional, their communication is misleading, and they do not stand by the information their own staff provides.

I will never go back there.
Also, the showers were ALWAYS cold by 8am during the week.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Aobakwe Kgalapa","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVmwEB1RIJJbLkMuWzUAbbf3yV3wfUBc6CsoSFfKN7T_yqmQoARtA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I would not advise anyone to join this gym, as they fail to protect clients’ sensitive personal information. It’s a decent option for a quick refresh, but I might keep looking for somewhere that feels a bit more personalized","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Shane Miln Olney","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUdKrFOOTGk16bJDDvoNgawZWRAbEzdSX5KVAJLmmfc3UNPqZWy=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I visited Jasmine Day Thai Spa today and, unfortunately, had the most unpleasant experience I’ve ever had there. I’ve been a loyal customer for years and have visited the spa more than eight times. I’ve also had over 200 Thai massages in my life, so I know what a proper Thai massage should feel like.

The therapist this evening was extremely rough to the point that it felt like she wasn’t sure what she was doing. There was no structure or flow in her technique, and my body and neck feel even worse now than when I walked in. My partner’s therapist even mentioned afterwards that she could see how inconsistent the massage was.

When I shared my feedback at reception, I was simply told “sorry,” but I was still charged the full amount. I don’t mind paying — this is not about the money. It’s about the principle and the customer experience. If a loyal customer has a genuinely bad experience for the first time, the spa should at least offer a gesture of goodwill, such as a complimentary or discounted session. That’s basic customer care.

Instead, I left feeling worse physically and disappointed emotionally. My neck and back are extremely tense after the session, and I honestly regret going. I’ve always supported Jasmine Day Thai Spa, but after this experience and the lack of acknowledgement from the front desk, I don’t feel valued as a returning customer.

I highly recommend them for people who like Thai Massage.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Angela Brans","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjW2wt_TNRYxcqzNXK2MMCnejWmpPK2NTLey0qIL7yHaj09LPg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Where do I start...from our arrival it was a comedy of errors:
1. Our bathroom - no toilet paper and no toilet seat, not even handwash
2. Our foot treatment was conducted in reception while people sat watching us. The exfoliation was so rough and sore that it took a layer off my skin. I'm still red, 3 days later
3. Then it came time for our full body massage. The beds were great - very wide and comfortable (hence the one-star). But I soon realised it wasn't for our comfort it was for the therapist to sit on while massaging. The worst part was that my much-awaited relaxation session resulted in a one-handed massage (I use that term loosely as it was more of a light touch). Eventually, I looked up to find the "therapist" on her cell phone watching videos, which explained the consistent hearing of buzzing sounds and bed vibrations every so often. I kindly asked her to please go outside and sort out whatever she needed to do on her phone and then come back to focus on the treatment. Who the hell sits on their cell while giving any type of spa treatment????
4. The back exfoliation was also brutal. I asked her to please stop as it was very sore, however, I think she thought I asked for more. I look like I have been burnt, 3 days later.
5. The head and neck massage never happened, nor did the hand massage. Or maybe it did which I clearly missed.
6. It was time for our jacuzzi and bottle of "champagne". There was no way we were climbing in the jacuzzi as god knows what we would find after seeing our bathroom so we politely declined. Our bottle of bubbles was some cheap red version, which even if we wanted to drink it we couldn't have because we weren't given any glasses.
7. Throughout the two hours that we were there we weren't even offered so much as a glass of water.
8. The best part of our spa day was seeing Sisa Thai Spa in my review mirror.
So here is my rating per treatment:
- Choice of full body massage: 0
- Back exfoliation: 0
- Foot cleansing: 0
- Head and neck massage: 0
- Hand massage: 0
- Couples jacuzzi session with a bottle of champagne: -0
Needless to say, I highly recommend that if you are looking to "relax and rejuvenate your body with stress-relieving treatments"  that are "focused on holistic wellness, healing both mind and body", this is not it! Spend more money if need be and buy any other spa package than this one. We did however laugh ourselves to tears.

UPDATE: The owner has responded to me and was lovely. I’ve even been offered a complimentary massage. Her reply to my review is very appreciated.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETII-TwIuMFZfh6wwwnW4ZhyU9LbHKKF0qCp8DoMqMPDfjD1rv_hV1JRhXv_zRll2iTvZsy9OPsJFTz5BKMB_XcVxijJDSIWaec7dFDz5lqFGu3DXzD77gkNu_QKQWepPeQPADH"],"When":"2023-10-23"},{"Name":"Ushir Moonilal","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJkSnc6iJB5Fh0A_cDM5zu_GAjHUrYyz_B4s8adUMUMeILAvw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Absolutely amazing experience. Fusionista you simply cannot believe that you are actually in Randburg. It feels as though you've been transported to a beach resort in Thailand. The psychedelic lighting and trippy decor adds to the feeling of being far away. I love that each room has it's own theme and personality. We did the couples rendezvous package which is great value for money. At less than R3000 per couple for three treatments and a three course meal. The massage in the koi room was divine, you feel totally relaxed with fish swimming beneath you, it feels like you really are in a rainforest. The rasul mud treatment is also very interesting and relaxing, my skin felt incredibly smooth after and it really helped with my dry heels. And the jacuzzi session was just what we needed to end off the experience.

On to the meal. While the full package is reasonable, Fusionista's menu is a bit chaotic and overwhelming. The lighting is also very strange and takes you away from the tranquil spa experience into more of a nightclub vibe. There are so many dishes, it will take you 30 minutes just to decide what to order, so best view the menu online beforehand. On the plus side they do seem to have everything offered on the menu, which is a good sign. However, I found the food a bit dated and some dishes were not particularly authentic, for example I had the duck and pancakes, however the pancakes were stock standard regular pancakes rather than the paper thin pancakes usually served with Peking duck. The sauce also consisted of a slightly off putting gloopy substance with whole stem maraschino cherries in it, which was not very practical to eat. Yet, I must commend the restaurant staff for really making my birthday special and making an effort with decorating my dessert, it does make a big difference.

So, I would say the spa is fantastic however the food could be I must be honest and state that the owner's responses to complaints made me hesitate. I personally don't believe dismissing the complaint is not the best approach to handling things as it means if I too have an issue in future, my complaint will also be dismissed. As someone who has customers myself, I know the customer is only right 50% of the time at best, but how we respond determines if lose them as a customer or not.

So, I took a gamble and boy did it pay off! From the security to the receptionist, to the masseuse, the service was impeccable!  The Spa is stunning! The reception area is breath-taking and IG or my pics won't do it justice. I love that they have a rabbit (could be more, but I only saw one) and chickens running around! They have a nice waiting area. I was on time and only had to wait less than a minute for Lebo (my masseuse) to come get me. The treatment room was spacious, and I love that they provide you with a nice sofa to sit on to take off your shoes. They even have shower facilities for those who wish to wash off the oils after the treatment. The bed was nice and big. To give context, I am a fairly big guy (1.74m @104kg) and I was very comfortable. Lebo has lovely personality and engaged with me just perfectly! I initiated conversation and she was friendly and professional throughout the treatment. I am sure should you wish not to speak, she would respect that as well. I love a firm treatment as I push my body and tend to get knotted up and she was on the money! I was surprised when my time ended. I will be booking a 2 hr treatment next time. I had booked a 1.5hr Sports Massage. I have had bad treatments that took forever as I was just waiting to get off the table, because the masseuse would not have applied my feedback. Lebo took on my feedback and acted on it immediately. I feel 10x better :)

After my treatment I was offered my choice of tea's or water. I chose a tea and it was served very quickly and it was nice and hot.

I have no complaints and would recommend to anyone looking for a clean, professional lovely experience. The only thing I am left to test is consistency, so I plan on doing a follow up review after I go back in a week's time for a 2hr Sports Massage.

I went back and yeah, the service is CONSISNTANTLY Great! I found my new Spa home :).

Service Date: 11 December 2025

After having powder brows done a few years ago that didn’t last, I spent nearly two years searching for the right artist.

Honestly, it was like a recruitment project—I filtered, shortlisted, and screened several salons. Not only did Blink Beauty Randburg come out on top, but I can confidently say I found the best candidates, the most incredible beings, in Yolanda and Yolandi.

From the very first welcome message to the professional phone call and the warm reception when I arrived at 14:30 on the 11th, Yolanda made me feel valued and cared for. Her professionalism and kindness set the tone for an exceptional experience.

Then came Yolandi—the true artist behind my brows. She took her time, explained every step, and ensured I was comfortable throughout. We all know our faces aren’t perfectly symmetrical, but thanks to Yolandi’s precision, care, and artistry, I now have perfectly shaped brows that complement my features beautifully.

Thank you, ladies, for the attention and dedication you showed from pre-booking to aftercare. I look forward to seeing you both on 20 January 2026 for my touch-up and the first session of my tattoo removal.

Best wishes,

[{"Name":"Molebogeng Stephina Ditinti","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJo2G8Z5fC1D92oJfRIFyr-Tefnycz37abCiouxS7KB36ZaXw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Do not take your car there if you love it,period!
and don't pay before you've test driven it.
I took my car to this garage on a Friday i December because the engine light was on and the car was stalling. The car stayed there until Tuesday. After diagnosing it, I was told the problem was the crank sensor.
I was charged R4,600 for the crank sensor replacement, even though the part itself does not cost anywhere near that amount if you check independently. After being told the car was “fixed” and ready, the engine light was still on, and the original stalling problem was not resolved.
I paid for the repair in good faith, but the issue I brought the car in for was never fixed. I would have appreciated accurate diagnosis and transparency before being charged for parts that did not solve the problem.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Christina Govender","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocIOtRRCixm1DtxLuhZacMybyn5X0wCWj12HdCJh_X36eh_0wg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"In August this year I took my car to car care clinic Little Falls for repairs. We waited for over a week and before we got the car back the manager was pushing for us to make payment before the repairs was done ,he said that they are trying to open up a new store and this will assist with the numbers on the books when he is motivating to his boss. Two days later we got a call to collect the vehicle and that it is ready, when we took the car back I got stuck with it at work again for the same issue. We then called car care clinic and they asked us to bring it back.we took it back and did not hear back from them until we tried calling 2 days later and we were informed that the shop burnt down in a fire yesterday and my vehicle along with all the other cars burnt down as well. They did not bother to call and inform me that my vehicle was burnt down. When trying to call the manager was non chalant about it and was only concerned that they lost R90 000 from their shop. I went to the scene of the fire and no one could care that the client's who's vehicles were in the shop was burnt down. They ignored my emails requesting that they pay back the money I paid for repairs as well as compensation for my vehicle. I had a paid up car therefore I was trying to repair the vehicle so that I did not have to buy a new 1. They refuse to cooperate and I have had to purchase a new vehicle which was not in my budget due to their negligence and to date they still do not want to admit liability and take responsibility for what they have done. Please do not take your vehicle to Car Care Clinic you would rather pay the extra money and take it to the relevant dealership to get value for your money and to be treated like your business matters. Avoid car care clinic at all costs.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Skulile Skenjana","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVyr0_74kqGWvll8mGGxXby9Soz8pflpt5zPKoEdHz8Mt5cqY5U=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Absolute negligence. I serviced my car here in December. In January, a petrol attendant checked my fluids and found there was no oil in the engine. I was forced to buy oil immediately to avoid catastrophic engine damage—something that could have been completely avoided if this service centre had done their job.

When I reported this, management admitted the technician who worked on my car had been fired for negligence, meaning this clearly wasn’t the first incident. They agreed to redo the oil change but refused to reimburse me for the oil I had to buy because of their mistake. I was expected to absorb the cost of their incompetence.

To make matters worse, the person I dealt with was unprofessional and dismissive throughout the process. This level of carelessness could have destroyed my engine. I would strongly advise anyone to think twice before trusting this service centre with their vehicle.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEST9ym8S7nGKgXMeV0tUKEvC866Kl7Ny_qlVstrXZpXYeumUybHO4djIzVU3TknJ3bjIGzOLS2t9h8_yPW8SyUqz1M_-RwRH5MHAWx8R2HwROuEnRitZ4DncOK69D7_KFtK1Kv1q-DOeaHh"],"When":"2026-2-7"},{"Name":"Linda Jenner","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVoEdCiG7VdcEVJ6UqGzHImTJQHu10aB5Cj387SEY2UeTd_eVMM=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Pleasant guy . Cost a lot more than we expected as a lot of parts were needing replacement.all seems good except someone drove the car a total of 25 kms and lost me Discovery points for speeding","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Jannie Glas","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVSKF38KCTp-hKqmA03VhJ8pF-mdB5Xpi9HqG30t9D0rzPYwKkW=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":""Very disappointed with the service here. After three separate visits and significant expense, my car is still not fixed. I've been patient, but returning three times for the same repair is unacceptable. I’m hoping management will reach out to resolve this, as I shouldn't have to keep paying for work that doesn't solve the problem."","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Michelle Richards","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK2SSOS6IMaNKJmcSCQRO7GPI7xF-lNJydAsYqQyFYAf_JWww=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I first serviced my car in July 2024 with Car Care Clinic Little Falls and was blown away by their customer care and service granted to me. My car went like a dream after that service. I took the vehicle back to the branch today for a rear brakes change and again, my car and myself were treated like royalty! Thank you so much to the staff at the branch and please know that you definitely have a customer for life!!! Thank you so much.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Revineo Juries","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLufO_QGk8AZ3jfOIEKTmCzwuKDu45-cx_NLEbCAqXkxIeQaw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Happy with there service I did get keep up there good work","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Simphiwe Mbuli","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVx1pPeBfP88Ne5OE9jTuaaFIzCB5wCDQhEkPLNo904M8GfzTolfg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I took my car there on Wednesday as the coolant water was leaking. They said they'll do a pressure test which they did. When collecting my car I was told the water pump is leaking and another pipe to the coolant was damaged. They offered to replace the water pipe for free as it was still umder warranty as they replaced it last year which I welcomed. To my suprise when I took the car and drove the accelerator was stiff, funny noise coming from the engine and engine light was on. I took it back and they said it was a breather pipe which was not properly fastened, but when they put it in the diagnostic machine it indicated that my cam shaft was faulty. The drama satrted as I questioned why all of a sudden after they pressure tested it. The mechanic said it was because the hole in the water pump has widened and their manager ranier disputed it. I told them that before they did pressure testing the car was fine and iddling normal. Worse part ranier wanted me to change the water pump from their workshop at a cost R11 700 whereas Audi Westrand the OEM sells it for R3300. As of now my car sounds and iddles like a bakkie and the engine light is still on as he did want the mechanics to clear it, which I requested them to do and they did and after driving for few kilometers it came back. The customer service is so back and they don't even bother to call you to give an update while working on your car. Replacing a pipe in my car on 10 April 2025 took more than 5 hours and I had to call them to check as to what was the hold up and no explanation procided other than a bad attitude from ranier. I will never take my car to any Car care clinic especially little falls one as there is zero customer service and even their mechanics are complaininv about the new manager. I you really love and value your car stay away from Car care clinic more so Little falls one. Ranier doesn't mind to swear at your as a customer if you ask difficult questions and he will leave you to talk alone as other customers are more important than you when you are not satisfied. He told me that he has a lot of customers to service other than addressing my complain and worse part he said he was so happy not to see me anymore in his workshop.","Images":null,"When":""}]

[{"Name":"Ochieng Okeyo","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK82SmJUjLYoRywpzdATjF7PRDR3VR-aEpQw2ymDTC3FQ23nw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"This clip shows diesel leaking atop my engine after 'repair' of injector and line by MEC. If you look through the reviews you will see that most of the really good ones are from years ago. The more recent ones are worse and worse. Maybe they are taking in too many vehicles. Maybe they have lost good staff. Nico can say why their service has become so bad. I've been stuck on the roadside twice in the last 8 months after I took my vehicle to them. It is true that the explanations of what has been serviced differ from person to person, sometimes totally unrelated. I have never been able to get my car back from them before a week is over and I have had to return it several times thereafter. Two weeks ago the vehicle went into limp mode because of the shoddy work they had done. The vehicle, which they said the took on a test drive, could not even get to the McDonalds up the road, barely a kilometre. Car was showing an engine light on the dash. It was running but I was worried that it could be a major problem. I took it in and after a couple of days with no feedback I spoke to Reneilwe. She said that it would be  ready that day. Something about a cable being the problem. When I called later I was told the vehicle would be ready the next day because they were busy re-loading its software. Following day I called again and was told that the problem was still there and that the software guy is coming in to re-load the software. Multiple calls later the guy hadn't come and will be there the following day. Following day the guy has come and re-loaded (I assume) new software. Meanwhile it is me calling the whole time, no feedback. Eventually I am told the car is ready. I fetch it. Pay some R10k odd including R7500 for software and it breaks down a km away can't go past 2300 revs, crawling at about 60km. I take it back immediately get Nico in the car and he sees how it is driving. Even he doesn't understand that it is not shifting gears even manually. I leave it there. Days pass, no feedback eventually I call and say I want my car back - its like if you don't complain they don't work on it - after another week I call and they say I can fetch it. Mechanic mentions that the hissimg sound is still there. Nico shuts him down. They had replaced a hose going into the turbo. Nico tells me has removed the new software and put back the old software. Problem is now fixed. No job card, nothing. Fast forward, about a week or so later same problem. But now I am out of pocket R10k... I take it back. This time it is worse. Car is there for a week and some days and I get 3 return calls from them - pretty much in the last 3 days when I have called them all week and I am at my wits end. They tell me one injector is faulty. The guy is coming in same day to collect it and recondition it. This is Dumisani's response. He will let me know how long it will take to repair and re-install as soon as the guy comes. Nothing. I call and I am told the guy didn't come. He is coming tomorrow morning. I call the following day about lunch time. The guy hasn't come. I call about 16:00 the guy has come and he has brought an injector with him. Dumi will give me feedback on whether or not I can come fetch my car that evening. He doesn't. I call and Dumi says the guy brought the wrong injector. He'll come back tomorrow morning. He doesn't. I call and talk to David and I am told he is coming. Eventually I call about 16:00 and the guy has come David is just going to test drive the car. I call about an hour later, the car is in the wash. I collect it. A wek later I am stuck on the N12 highway just before Daveyton. I am not going back to Nico","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESDAO18wFpZcvUzrcCtuH55ezrp2QcOHbMuWeZdMXR5GmGgXV6aqzYTZOWp2VKhE3BZlhNQqtQkzix_IwuCv1pnZiGn9h7ti_MXsi3Ja94KCi5YZhEWrd9ynsZB-ENOQXCj-oaolhBYlnp9"],"When":"2026-2-26"},{"Name":"Mickayla Govender","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVvVzA1Eg4eNoS7B0Mcm7XhC2Db2OpBHtBd57ALkmfAE9KpEwFprA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Life-threatening!!

Took my car to Merc Auto world for a service and other work performed to the value of R14 377. Part of this amount related to R3947 charged for labour. During work performed my wheel was not screwed on properly. After picking up my car from Merc Auto and driving on the freeway, I kept hearing a shuddering noise coming from my wheel. Had to find closest mechanic who inspected the vehicle and told me only 3 out of 5 bolts were loosely on the wheel, and showed me how close the wheel was to falling off. Imagine, this wheel came off doing 120km/hr on the freeway, would have ended extremely badly for myself and everyone else on the road. Just grateful to have stopped in time to get it checked. See picture mechanic took of only 3 bolts loosely on wheel.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEROR4uvakJgCx9beb7nX7M5NLeUwgyXHzFQE8BimOZiVf5dyJe5qjFToOnxbJSSj8mR5w9jeWcnqlJrB56ENm8bZUDiQ7pk35XUJeBrscuBNrF55y2KG93qbZ-bf9Eh5z4ArQeStxMDi_xJ"],"When":"2026-1-19"},{"Name":"Ben Stewart","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK8npJlN8vKqa8LfsYl-bdppYAEHHW45fgn1pBauoi_zIhl8w=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"R14 000 worth of work done. The next day, the wheel is almost coming off the car on the freeway, and some of the wheel nuts are missing.

It's shocking to pay that amount of money and have your life in danger because they're too lazy to put the wheel back properly after doing suspension work.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESKHiWi4A7WqFQKIRrwV-fjGa2G4qG1BzNRRbXamVo0OKekvxwXmpBkE_ocsVDQ3NIAZnrKcEBLABavjUPQvSSTI3_B4kdPcT_wCrQcQR0fyl0qdQe7rOfCxKO0dpWIKpa2IOUJP0E6n0nN"],"When":"2026-1-16"},{"Name":"Quantum Quantum","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUjrn-y4JeniRD6GhWXpYm7UqtXF1NQtDoeAqScD6PK5J5h27Ns=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Nico and his team are excellent at what they do .he explained everything to me and even though he didt have the part he let me source my own part and Installed it at a good price . Only complaint i have is when calling in the front admin doest communicate very well. If it was not for the excellent reviews I would have walked away but I am grateful I didt . They absolutely know what they are doing","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Thobani Ngcoya","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVhUJ40PbzKHdk0RMuJ115JPa388TWymr72xox_muTxYKFfQcwL1Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Deeply Disappointing Experience Marked by Poor Communication, Inflated Costs, and Shifting Explanations

I am updating my review to address the workshop’s response, which unfortunately leaves out key facts and misrepresents the situation.

From the start, communication was unclear and inconsistent. I was never given a proper, itemised engineering report or a written explanation of why “engineering work” was suddenly required. What I received instead were vague verbal statements, unexplained additional fees, and moving targets — all while the price for parts was marked up to nearly five times the normal cost.

A repair quoted to take 4 days dragged out for 2 months, during which I repeatedly had to follow up myself, as updates were rarely provided.

Their claim that I “refused essential engineering work” is inaccurate. I asked for transparency:

a written breakdown of the supposed engineering work,

the actual cost,

and why it was not included in the original quotation.

None of this was provided. Instead, I was told to simply pay an extra, undefined amount, and when I questioned it, I was threatened with having my warranty cancelled — an unacceptable and unprofessional tactic.

No responsible customer should approve work without clear documentation or justification. Requesting transparency is not “cutting corners”; it is standard practice.

If Merc Autoworld believes in professionalism and transparency, then clear communication, consistent pricing, and documented quotations should be the baseline, not the exception.

My experience was the opposite, and I stand by my review. I strongly advise others to approach with caution and insist on full written explanations before agreeing to anything.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Barry Corbett","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVKzpy1xByxJjzE4bkrS5d-SspZHI30TyASrb8y_eRU-62EaOLIDA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Three years of continued excellent service ... thank you Nico/Dumi/Mzwandile ... highly recommended","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERiIKsPCfNr1vwALsmen95w2E4d8yc8-bs2nU59mLylljFI4FdWsOWPNTXzWmk7zhbLTYnMPz3cqRqEZfxoHRlBz-XNzWIegMGC8ULtGphU9c2eADT5d_jftiXKSCUSC8b2MNBq","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lER1f6YzD6cRB7SH3_45KordByOAFTQ2INXinFKO-82jb4U71sB__Z70oi2AYwIPzan_S3WkWF5b2PBYvFqXXzYQV4pSLAU20SnTIqvitCrHSiS3z4sryzLtRs2s9tPgiPLlAQkf","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESTNzaJcAk6W4FQPhLOoVkes4yxrOGKeKDYCsjdOq9RbO9_iwPLry1Evwq_rgWfYtUfTdLctNv_apXNqhTvs3XEIrmCto05p1BIcs1r3-NobQokbV_uxSwSmvcz37IaH9xylmSJNw"],"When":"2020-5-14"},{"Name":"Wendy Stenner","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLrUxeI-518sZvQ7dVMTvd6iqP_zORes-_R-Iai8TWHkQ949g=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My car was towed to Merc Autoworld having broken down. I was quoted R173k by Arnold Chatz because they couldn't find the problem with why the timing on my car wouldn't come right and they wanted to replace the engine They kept making me pay for new units and parts until I had paid them almost 50k and the car was no closer to driving than previously. From now on, these are the guys who I trust entirely with the fiat 500 which I drive and a colleague will be taking her fiat there in future too. Instead of costing 173k for an engine, I paid alfia 22300 which included all the time that it took to find , fix the initial problem, replace  parts that had been broken in the process of others messing around in the bonnet and removing parts that shouldn't have been removed,  and then put everything back together. I thank Giovanni too as I know that he too helped to solve this matter. He knows his stuff, shows his passion too and is a legit expert. Clayton gave me a call to say that they would replace the pipe and were going to have it specially made up by a local company. The cost was reduced considerably.
They also replaced the fluid reservoir as well as the rear window winder mechanism (which I had provided). Another really nice surprise was that they had taken to the trouble to not only clean the car but the engine as well!
The cost for the entire job was extremely reasonable and I will have no hesitation in taking my 159 to them in the future.

[{"Name":"Lemeez Chilwan","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV1dVGek-in61XMq00FvAcUuRqr3remwyAfG3u8ZWrGiXwZ4ANd=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"If Google allowed me to give 10 stars, then that’s how high I would rate the exceptional service I received from The Garage at 100 Rivonia Road, Sandton.

I was greeted by friendly staff and the owner himself, Arthur Jaffer, who clearly loves what he does. Not only did he go above and beyond to assist me, he went the proverbial extra mile. He was only meant to replace my brake pads but upon discovering that the ABS light was still on, he investigated further and discovered a serious issue which he immediately sought to remedy (I’m a lawyer not a mechanic so I’m not exactly sure what the issue was - a wire had been cut).

Conveniently located adjacent to Sandton City, I was able to take a short stroll to buy a late lunch while The Garage worked on my car.

I highly recommend The Garage and plan to service my car there.

I observed the rapport Arthur has with his customers and how happy everyone was.

Thank you Arthur and your phenomenal team! On Tuesday afternoon, 25 November @ around 5pm (closing time for most), I had a crisis. I needed to get from Bryanston to Meyerspark (Pretoria, towards Silverton), in PEAK traffic and I had discovered that my bakkie's coolant was below minimum and the coolant bottle's cap was busted - I couldn't fill the bottle.

I stopped by The Garage Bryanston and explained my situation. A lot of places would have told me sorry, we are closing. But these guys jumped in without a second thought or query. The technician (assisted by the manager) had to physically break the cap's inner out of the bottle, without damaging the bottle, which he managed successfully, with caution, after some time.

But, the cap was totally busted and the bottle open. They did not have a replacement cap for me. So, what did they do? THE REMOVED THE CAP OFF THEIR OWN DELIVERY VEHICLE AND GAVE IT ME! Also filling my coolant bottle to the max level.

Best of all, when I asked what I owe them, because of the huge help they were, especially a that time of day (I would have paid anything at that stage, because I thought I was screwed), the manager's response was "nothing".

Thank you guys for your excellent service! I hope this review helps you in some small way, as I think this is probably the least I can do, along with saving your shop in my memory bank, so that I make use of your services in the future if I am ever in the area again.

Thanks again, keep up the good work!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Carmen Ingram","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocL8kUqg8Yo8ZqYLf3gNnqzSBHHY69A72ZGgscn8FsEfaMRB=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I took my Mini to The Garage at Hobart in Bryanston for repair work, and I couldn’t be happier with the service I received. The workers generally don’t know anything about how cars scratch or how swirl marks appear. I’ll break down my experience of the car wash:
- firstly they rinse the car with a pressure hose, which is great. However they tend to focus on upper parts of the car and neglect sills and rims where most dirt/dust reside
- they then put some sort of snow foam which doubles as the car shampoo/suds. This seems very rushed as while they still spraying the snow foam onto the car there’s another person who goes straight into the rims with a sponge 🧽. This is bound to scratch the rims as firstly a sponge is known to trap dirt and grit which will drag across the paint and secondly they’ve neglected the rims with the snow foam so bound to scratch. Snow foam should also sit for about 5 min but do understand it’s about getting through volume of Cars.  They should however use microfiber mits or clothes.
- they don’t use two bucket method nor do they rinse the sponges from car to car or between washing panels. Bound to get swirl marks.
- the touch wash is very haphazard with strokes in multiple directions and a lot of hand pressure. Again bound to cause swirl marks.
- they do however use bug spray to remove dead bugs before rinsing which is a plus.
- the drying process is also quite harsh. No drying aid is used and they use a chamois cloth which although ok for drying still isn’t the most ideal. A microfiber towel would be better and strokes should be light touch and in one direction.
- rims are painted black and we’re still visibly dirty after the wash.

So in conclusion great for older cars or if you don’t care for some scratches and swirl marks. But not a high-end place. I will take my polo there but not any new Cars.","Images":null,"When":""}]

I noticed the same gentleman was wearing bracelets which were hitting against my car. I informed the person at the till of this as a point of feedback post the wash (before the vacuum).

They quickly diagnosed the real culprit: a failing mechatronic unit—the brain of the transmission. Instead of pushing for a prohibitively expensive full replacement, they expertly repaired and re-sealed the unit, which is a highly specialized job.

What really impressed me was their deep knowledge of specific German engineering issues. It’s clear they don’t just fix cars—they save them. Last week I was at Sandton City for an early morning meeting and needed my car cleaned urgently. I arrived just before 8am and asked one staff member if they could help me with a quick wash as I only had 30 minutes, but unfortunately there was no interest in assisting me.
I decided to leave, then drove back to try my luck again. That’s when I met another staff member, Zama. I explained the same situation, and without hesitation he agreed and asked me to park the car, promising to do his best.
I went for a short walk and returned at the time he said the car would be ready — and I was honestly shocked. The car was spotless, inside and out. He even cleaned the seats as if he had all the time in the world.
I tipped him to show my appreciation and also told the lady at the pay point how amazing Zama is.
I’ve had a bad experience with Plush Car Wash before, but Zama completely restored my faith. Service is what we pay for, and it’s people like him who save a business’s reputation through kindness, professionalism, and genuine care — whether someone is paying or not.

From the quality of their products to the pride they take in their workmanship, it shows that standards truly matter to them.

What stands out most is consistency. Every visit delivers the same high level of finish, the same friendly service, and the same reassuring sense that your vehicle is being treated with respect. The staff are welcoming, the location is convenient, and the turnaround time is impressive without sacrificing quality.

If you value proper care, brilliant detailing, and service that feels both premium and personal, CarSPA Wanderers absolutely delivers. [{"Name":"Brandon Chetty","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV2ml4Dcz3MZmav2F6teeZ6KluauvIxnOe2U7voIfK5ksGyzTM=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Recently had my mother-in-law’s Citroën DS5 serviced at Shox Suspension Centre, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Shaun and Jonathan provided excellent service and genuinely honest advice. They helped source the necessary parts, guided us through the process, and had everything installed quickly and professionally. Their labour rates are very reasonable, and communication both via WhatsApp and over the phone was consistently clear and helpful. Highly recommend Shox!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Derek Martin","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjV7ub6zDvs4ISLm5GjT9y1mgLoXle5na54RWa_6TgtOzaA9vN0b9Q=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I was really impressed with the friendliness and customer service that this company provided. They offered real advice and practical suggestions for dealing with some problems with my car suspension. With fantastic service like this, they are a company that I can really highly recommend.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Tayedza Mbiri","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWpBTr71sWz0avz1F18aEXbhIgqY25YC9Y4h7-s_57pcMFR1b9L=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":2,"Description":"I heard about Shox Suspension when a few mates of mine shared their experiences with me. Plus it was quite convenient since it was near home and work. So I had a bit of a big job when time came to re-do the whole suspension system on my Subaru Impreza GT. I decided to have the work done in early December 2024 as that's when I had amassed all the parts and funds to get the job sorted.

I chatted beforehand with Shaune to have the work done, agreed on a price, date and timeline to complete the work. This included changing out the shocks, springs, ball joints , front and rear control arms, various bushings and rubbers and additionally, a request to paint the rear crossmember and differential crossmember if it was possible... To which they agreed.

The car was delivered on the week before everything was set to close for the December holidays. Unfortunately there was a hick up where the rear differential support bushings were removed by mistake. These were replaced recently but I admit fault for not letting Shox know about this but they resolved that with fitting Group N bushings at no additional cost to me. The car was finished on time.

The car handles like a dream now and this review has been overall positive but why did I give this such a low rating then?

Earlier on in the review , I mentioned that I made a request to have the crossmembers be repainted. They were going to be out of the car in any case  since their bushings were going to be stripped and replaced. On a day when I came to look at the progress, the differential Xmember was painted and reinstalled while the suspension Xmember was waiting to be refitted.

Fast forward through the December holidays, I needed to get another job under the car sorted. When I jacked up the car, to my surprise, the suspension Xmember wasn't painted. I messaged Shaune about this politely to which he told me and I paraphrase, that they couldn't repaint the Xmember because there was a greasy/oily substance on the part that they couldn't strip. So you're telling me, that a standard degreaser, NOT ACID, couldn't remove that in preparation for paint, and when the differential Xmember is mounted next to the suspension Xmember, that same so-called grease would be there on that part as well no? I call foul.

In addition to this, I noticed my rear seat backs weren't put back properly and I decided to sort this myself discovering also that one of the original bolts to mount the seat had gone missing and was replaced with a different bolt. Now I had to chase the threads so they wouldn't strip.

If the suspension Xmember couldn't be painted then fine, it was an additional request that isn't really part of the suspension wheel house but at the very least, inform me about it and charge me less if that's the case then I would have understood.

Very clearly this is also a lesson for me to not arrange big jobs just before a holiday because clearly there was a bit of a rush. This isn't just a Shox issue but with other workshops I've seen that this is the case.

As far as fixing suspension items go, the guys know their stuff and I haven't had problems on the suspension side of the story.

From routine maintenance to more complex repairs on my out-of-service-plan vehicles, their team consistently delivers excellent service that's prompt, professional, and thorough. Their booking process is seamless – a quick call or message and you're in, with the team always going out of their way to accommodate your schedule, even on short notice.
What stands out most is their reasonable rates – no hidden fees or unnecessary upsells, just honest work at fair prices. I've often compared them to dealerships, and Fangio comes out on top every time: better communication, quicker turnaround, and a genuine care for the customer that you don't always get from the big names. The mechanics are knowledgeable, friendly, and always take the time to explain issues in plain language without making you feel rushed.
If you're in Randburg and need reliable auto care without breaking the bank, Fangio Auto Services is the place to go. Highly recommended – they'll treat your car (and your wallet) right!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Reid Morrison","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLknIYCjyPZb5fDhPs2ynbuL_BpqynPRBxvFfMykKD6YdFaeg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Please get a second opinion before trusting your car with these guys. I called a trusted contact who confirmed my suspicions, that these guys are taking chances. And this job would cost no more than R2 000. The trusted contact checked the car, found no issues with the cooling system and the car is still running without issues. We chalked it up to being an odd incident where the fan didn't switch off. [{"Name":"Lindani Afika Majalumani","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocLWiiobvQndhkAOifvUolUmyY_qaEeEWzvucc1igSqH-p5LAA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"My car had an issue over the holidays and after a misdiagnosis by Mazda. I contacted Mumbo Repairs and Neo logged in my call. The car was booked in for the following morning and, when I delivered it the following morning, Neo took over and kept me updated the whole time. After the diagnosis, Neo explained that the car had a misfire resultant from a faulty injector on cylinder 1 and appraised me of all the options available to me together with the accompanying costs. We settled on an option and the parts were ordered, meanwhile the vehicle was handed back to me until the delivery of the parts. After the delivery of the parts, the vehicle was booked in for the following day by Neo. I delivered the vehicle on a flatbed at 8h45 because it suddenly refused to start and I didn’t want to risk anything. To my surprise, Neo called me during lunchtime, discussed the procedure undertaken and that repairs had been undertaken. The speed and efficiency by Neo and the Technician were greatly appreciated. Upon collection, Neo took me through all the necessary paperwork, the appropriate warning following the repairs and requested to be kept up to date about the condition of the car, in spite that their work was already finished. Mumbo repairs handled my vehicle and the issues I had well, and Neo was particularly exceptional.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Godfrey Mashego","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU164XNA87is1FWdSBiYft6VdgA9puZ8WxgfdwZvlU7us54_Pmz=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Dear Neo,
We had never met before I came to fetch my car, my car was towed to Mumbo Repairs and I wasn't present when it was delivered, this was after you arranged for a tow-truck. And you kept me updated from when you logged a ticket, the first checks, and the preceding stages in resolving the issues, you kept me abreast with the additional work required to be done other than what I had brought the car for. The car is doing absolutely well.
Thank you. "My Good Sir"","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Koketso Mashego","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXk9SrOmof3zndH_phsonDI5EVRMflUA-oo8qWxJS7l3eyn2Gs=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Just wanted to reach out and say thank you for the great service on the car's suspension overhaul, yes a complete suspension overhaul.

My VW is very happy now 😊

Only issue, and I only realised when I got home. They didn't give me a Mumbo repairs sticker.

I absolutely recommend them","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Mzimkhulu Twala","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKTkkEwVKN3tzUoXnZyDi6CKwbqghwJhSTWbTaz7Kilp_bFbA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I took my Mercedes ML 350CDi car in for turbo repairs at Mumbo Auto Service centre. They went on and fix my cars according to what I'm telling them to do. I really appreciate guys and definitely Mumbo repairs is giving me a peace of mind 🫶🏽","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Raphael Coopen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJwcDazAwcNiEPoEXpHkcLTxundT2KA6xzfok84ReYekFrj3Q=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Mumbo Repairs Randburg provided outstanding service throughout my recent visit. The shop is well-organised, which immediately gave me confidence in the quality of their work. The staff was knowledgeable and went above and beyond to ensure that my car was in top-notch condition. They took the time to explain the repairs that were needed and provided me with a detailed estimate, which helped me to make an informed decision.
What really stood out to me, though, was the level of customer service that was provided. The staff at this auto repair shop truly went above and beyond to make sure that I was satisfied with their work. They took the time to answer all of my questions, and even provided me with tips on how to keep my car running smoothly in the future.
Overall, I would highly recommend the Kings Auto shop to anyone in need of vehicle maintenance or repair. They are knowledgeable, and provided excellent customer service. I left feeling confident that my car was in good hands, and I will definitely be returning for all of my future vehicle needs. Thank you, Kings Auto for providing such an excellent experience!","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Adam Kara","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKb0C_H8C6OZpX3nu5fvJyyViePYUNnG9Q9fepfMToK50yW-A=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"Highly recommend!

It's rare to find such great service and honesty, where a company actually saves you money after agreeing to a quote. The workshop is super clean, equipped with high grade tools and diagnostic equipment.","Images":null,"When":""},{"Name":"Lavanya Govindsamy","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjXA3DVKLRzndUUS_NTmTlTFnSUQzMF6nuW68Qk_Cl00AFC6x4vN=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"Terrible service from Kings Auto. I was intially charged for wheel alignment, while driving it was very obvious that the alignment was not done and I had to take it to another establishment. When I called the company who apparently did the alignment was based in Durban and had no idea what I was talking about. A few days later, the left hand side shock started making noises at this point I did not trust Kings Auto enough to take my car back. I took my car to another mechanic whom advised that both of the shock mountings were damaged and the bolts were stripped. I am absolutely disappointed that I had to pay twice to get this sorted out and I will not take my car back to an establishment that I cannot trust. user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Taylor Rautenbach","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJc0PnjIL6yFUEmU8nI7Gf7HTEqPQsvf7FQOkUTWaAQGb76P9k=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I am not writing this to tarnish Drive Doctor’s reputation, but I do believe other drivers deserve to be aware of my experience.

I took my car in on Monday, 23 February, because it was making a strange grinding/rolling drum-type sound. The inner CV joint was replaced and the vehicle was returned to me later that same day. Unfortunately, when I left the centre the original sound was still present. I immediately turned around and informed the mechanic.

When I got home and began cleaning the car, I noticed the vehicle had been returned in an appalling condition, with grease and brake dust covering both the interior and exterior from work done on the wheels. While cleaning the car and checking the wheel cap, I also noticed thick grease splattered inside the wheel arch. Upon closer inspection, I discovered that the outer CV boot had been torn, with grease thrown around the wheel area. I immediately contacted the manager to inform him of the condition of the vehicle.

The car then remained with them until the 25th. During this time, they replaced the CV boot and also replaced the left wheel bearing as well as the right wheel bearing and hub. To their credit, the left bearing and boot replacement were covered by the workshop due to the inconvenience caused.

However, when the car was collected on the 25th, the issue occurred again. Grease was once again being thrown from the CV boot. It was then discovered that the boot had been fastened with cable ties instead of the correct clamps. I contacted the manager again to inform him of the situation.

The vehicle had to be returned again on the morning of the 26th. We had to stand there and watch as the car was taken apart and reassembled with proper clamps. On this occasion, the manager did feel the need to be on the premises even though there was still an issue.

Unfortunately, later that same day the problem occurred yet again, with grease still leaking from the CV boot. At this point, we had to go and purchase new clamps ourselves and secure the boot properly in order to finally resolve the issue.

While the problem was eventually resolved, the process involved considerable frustration due to the repeated visits, time lost, petrol, additional wear and tear, communication challenges, and days without reliable transport.

It could have been extremely dangerous had I not noticed the condition the vehicle was left in. While I appreciate that some of the repairs were covered by the workshop, the overall experience has made it difficult to fully regain trust. I would strongly encourage drivers to carefully inspect their vehicles after any repair work is completed.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESkMEogdtnXY68fhUsU9UR7KZNUnkqfodUySyUADGidk1Qajm9DJfbKY19uA48EEHjk3O0UM64uw2AYnWtHChtSkG9mhpILssO0WJL-2VuKTf99Fy0mfEK5D3d_O_iI2eyK-PG1YPFhwOEY","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERmqyba9YkvciQhnmOMvElQ1zfY5_Ppm8Iyatc8q-y5vg5SyuC5XeZIEKTLNwxueEGcvOOeq6qBlAPgxOlYtOf28nCZX7UTAknMQsnum6Ni83F4b7nqah9pCT8IcjEJUkgD1VqoIAKTc5Qs","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETZplMjQQXzXCUjtsDQJKZmdeK7l4Le9F21ZyklzIfrvTZ6o9zEYfHvoNhfbtbPPFZ5Ksjg4O7PYgS6c0qdVfPoAgmbFB8A5q-aTO4rNCSn-6iPn8LWu6rgv33_R0_yQzDy9PF9QQww-ks","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESFZOjeSRbtrS98XJ-bmm5CIExSQ4vNs0f6LQQ8ls0ljoBm7FCS4huzc_zG80x9IN5oe-0JIT39zwjJFTQaWc6EQ9Lza73XeVfhHTJcFZQIZ7kzmEXlnwSFjDOJ0h_2Lt88-lHrR555S_hy","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETLuP2E6aqaRGBkFIMtevc-pZT1tgXUy28vGptsOyDJ9DI7_0TPcmPP9PlFL-MgWeiestmoU1wS6lzl1jTT1OUyiHGmg31OqrZDBKOfEbc6yxtw3P-et5l_2qu-BXTmTf-s_f74AH9fEQf-","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lET9RHGMbSChQ0MbPR8h37hvEHyYr7JMBw_hfkHRyy6tAYkW8jRDblZu-aKrRRkGYuOCQ3HfxtGI7Eo4jzSCcQ3TwoTN5G9cQ0BczIktMbG8dTOQrvJfRvyKVQjCQs2j39jlbwPi_eutYM8","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESEdOoupROZYICTO9GY3Ec0BLxfcQdhMDXM_INklU3jPm5e4DFa4hHj9gij4-YvZhPW4q69W1jbCU1Duw01hxNasdde6xgCQ7W2zdTBMFKhgu9Cqk4hEHbIN5ljJZiTmvPjbhIrs_-OzIEc"],"When":"2026-3-5"},{"Name":"Jordan Robers","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJ13OAFUliC5QgQmM6vErxGjzK_BCNO01EP24vf66fdAp1MxA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I 110% recommend drive doctor. [{"Name":"Dillon Du Plessis","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJc7Z0ECk6evmWkHMrP8LhLYNM2z6kMNXJRhLb-JGUa7qBthw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"### Terrible Review for NetFlorist

I had the misfortune of ordering flowers from NetFlorist, and I can confidently say it was one of the worst experiences I've ever had. My order (ID: 108910563) was delivered on January 31, 2026, and the state in which my wife received her flowers and card was nothing short of appalling.

The flowers were basically ruined. They were lying on their side in the trunk of the delivery driver's car, and to top it off, one of the leaves was broken in two. As if that wasn't bad enough, the card was printed skewed and overlapped onto the second page—completely unacceptable! I’ve attached photos to illustrate just how substandard the quality was.

When I tried to address the issue, I was told I had to wait until Monday to file a complaint. Really? That’s how you treat your customers? After finally getting through to customer service, I was met with vague responses and no real assistance. Their replies felt scripted and insincere, and I was left feeling ignored and frustrated.

Despite my follow-up inquiries, I received nothing but the same generic responses, making me feel like I was talking to a robot rather than a customer service representative. It’s now February 9, and I’m still waiting for a resolution!

If you’re considering using NetFlorist, I strongly advise against it. Save your money and your sanity. There are plenty of other floral services that will treat you and your order with the respect you deserve.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETf5dQHnXIez25wrvFysi-Sb7WHRpnSUSM3Cq3r-1Hx6p4PnOJBqdnA_RfQ-bNitNr0j9zG7if2_fGcsHKZuZszV3bRnmPzVZStNpATljeQhN6aMX-0olpVmSoRX13ahOg_q8OB4RT5_9qF","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lEQzr2L16OHE9tLJrisz2m6bJrYj5H7map3JOjcYuMypw6NwpHb4Uqqqjw4HD7TMm5h_e3m9oTotywe7VXoDYTOVoUPYqwKToymFDSPObfSAaDaBJbFI_zKvA_ysb5cMCHRYffDmNuVA9BA","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERTdsQxt-LcTuanFFTJ5ZGpjsjgZNcVhcKi1ZHt8ryvzRA4B3TAjcEpVgY_iafvMJl8rnzCIHA1iqt4-ykwNerIR8mQ2nopCKmyhG3ir-epHLCd75NhukQPtuYAHsiNKoqH_5uKjWi7y2yE"],"When":"2026-2-9"},{"Name":"Winile Mothsoane","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUTzhXr3LComkQRs7uHTGQ4we8vZXmtb4WPX4BSkRbt_L26sP4a=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I had a beautiful bunch of roses delivered to me, they looked stunning and wrapped beautifully. 2nd pic was 5 days later, they looked even better. My boyfriend went out of his way to make my birthday special. He ordered a beautiful bouquet of flowers and a package of goodies for me with a guaranteed next day delivery on my birthday. It sounds simple enough, right? Well, apparently not for NetFlorist.

On the day, I only received the package of goodies. No flowers. No explanation. No apology. Nothing.
Imagine waiting all day on your birthday for the main gift only for it to never arrive.

And then here is the absolute cherry on this disaster of a cake. The flowers finally arrived the next day in a state so sad, so limp, and so depressing that calling them sad is me being extremely generous. It looked like they were dragged behind the delivery van. Or possibly stepped on. Or maybe they just picked the leftovers from yesterday’s reject pile and hoped I would not notice.

This is not the service they advertise. This is not what you expect when someone pays good money to make a special day actually special. The entire point of a florist is timely, fresh, presentable flowers. NetFlorist managed to fail at all three.

If ruining birthdays was the goal, they deserve 10 out of 10.
If delivering what was promised, they get 0 out of 10.
Will I ever trust them again? Absolutely not.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lERHj55kYIioBDyRREeFPCuUpttiwKk1QOS0QP8OUvrR2by2lC2VGskzpKdHhWM0-6Glbt7BbhLwsTZGQ-DA16NN03CclSqcAI7QTaLoPTTWCDQDjaqVey7PyhG_8UNaF0ucfF1CQUJ6LoAi","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lETpwIwkfr-Pq0rJ6V5HurzrYfHIJQ0RD_p4tcOgcUrOutZxdG0anf8kJkn3YnQBCk-p8agNxGEj51MBTDuE76i_2ezhQJs8FT4dylAbf5vEUljJ86j36nI1LRep7IraoqNpFWIH6BY3jckg"],"When":"2025-11-28"},{"Name":"Emmanuel Kasanya","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjU4hIeiHruhGPKBThnP4a7poPxp28jIe9wpsX76tyr9lnOGCMRDKw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":5,"Description":"I’m beyond grateful for this amazing service. The roses were absolutely beautiful, fresh, elegant, and delivered with care. Seeing how happy my fiancée was made everything worth it, especially since I’m not in the same country. Thank you for helping me express my love in such a meaningful way. Truly appreciated ❤️","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/geougc-cs/AMG9lESNQJo_o2yg7b8dpWeJNaZxT0J3alyhG97w40j-hnQQy0il-Dop2JuxeTLMNQTQh1sztFcQRTDILSHR6D9o7v2sdTWEgThGbsPvIVPFnNbJp73RiRB-baKI0T3zGY-F6IZCtyLGRzyJrzA"],"When":"2026-1-20"},{"Name":"Zani van Rooyen","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKpepEOdIpN90HMsl_Fit-HKkh4h37JoX-vLlATVBJ1XPzFvg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"I ordered the X-Large bouquet for my father’s funeral, a moment that was already emotionally devastating, and what I received added to that heartbreak instead of bringing comfort.
The bouquet delivered was very small and extremely disappointing, and looked nothing like what was advertised when ordering. It was absolutely not what you expect when you choose and pay for an X-Large arrangement, especially for something as significant as a funeral.
When I complained, I was told to wait for the lilies to bloom. Sadly, by the time the lilies eventually opened, the roses were already dead. This completely defeated the purpose, as the flowers were meant to honour my dad on the day of the funeral — not days later.
What made it even worse was seeing the bouquet in the church: small, unimpressive, and with no lilies in bloom at all. It was heartbreaking and embarrassing during such an important farewell.
This experience was emotionally wrecking and deeply disappointing. At a time when compassion, quality, and care matter most, this service fell far short. I work in Kenya but live in Linden, and I can honestly say that in all my years, I’ve never come across a pet parlor quite like Groom Room. For the first time, my animals aren’t terrified or traumatized by a grooming experience — instead, they come out looking amazing and feeling calm.

The staff at Groom Room are nothing short of incredible. I had the pleasure of interacting with all three team members, and each one was kind, well-presented, and genuinely passionate about their work. I initially wanted to have my kitten shaved, but the staff took the time to educate and advise me, showing real care for my pet’s well-being rather than just doing what was requested.

I have a nervous dog prone to panic attacks and a high-energy puppy with endless energy, but the Groom Room team handled them with remarkable patience, love, and compassion. The level of attentiveness and gentle care they provided was extraordinary — I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

As a first-time customer, I’m thrilled to have finally found a pet groomer that values both aesthetics and the emotional well-being of the animals they care for. I’ll definitely be back, and I’ll be leaving a gleaming review on our travel blog, Adventure Lifestyle Magazine.

Whether you’re a local or a traveler passing through, Groom Room is hands-down the best place for your furry companions. Their service is simply excellent, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone seeking a top-notch grooming experience.

— JJ Coetzee
Founder, Adventure Lifestyle Magazine

I initially hesitated to share my experience , unsure if my emotions were clouding my judgement. However, after much time and a recent recommendation from another individual to try this parlour prompted me to revisit and share my concerns, hoping to encourage improvement. In the beginning, I'd have given 5 stars due to the groomer's exceptional skill. However, a bad experience with Wayne, the owner, in July left a lasting negative impression.

- Previous grooms were great, but the July session was traumatic for my pup (no fault of the groomer himself), who has extreme anxiety due to a previous traumatic experience from another parlour.
- Wayne was well aware of her needs (and previously mastered professionalism) but was rude and irritated during the July groom (I was not around so my mom dealt with it that day). Upon arriving home my mom informed me of what occurred.
- I voiced concerns via WhatsApp (didn’t blame - merely inquired and left space for Wayne to give his side), but Wayne read and ignored them, offering no apology or response. Everyone has bad days but his inability to take responsibility/inability to offer an explanation/his side is what ultimately swayed my decision to never use this parlour again.
